Firstly, the dynamic behavior data of personnel are collected using multiple sensors such as the built-in accelerometer, gyroscope and heart rate sensor of the helmet. Then, the Kalman Filtering (KF) algorithm is used to pre-process the sensor data to remove noise and supplement the missing key data. Then, the different sensor data are integrated through the weighted fusion method, and the SVM (Support Vector Machine) and CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) machine learning models are combined to detect and predict abnormal states. Finally, the system transmits the processing results to the central control platform through the wireless communication module to achieve real-time monitoring and early warning. Experiments show that when using Kalman filtering, the application of Kalman filtering in the construction site environment significantly improves the detection accuracy (90%) and reduces the false alarm rate (10%) and missed alarm rate (4%). This method effectively improves the data processing capability of smart safety helmets in dynamic environments and enhances their response speed to dangerous events, providing reliable technical support for the safe application of smart safety equipment in the industrial and construction fields.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning Based Collaborative Energy Management for Base Station and Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: With the rapid expansion of 5G networks, the number of base stations and their energy consumption have significantly increased, making energy efficiency a critical challenge. To address this issue, this paper proposes a collaborative energy management model for 5G base stations and microgrids. By introducing the FL-PPO algorithm, the model achieves collaborative optimization while protecting base station data privacy. The base stations utilize the FL-PPO algorithm to implement dynamic sleep strategies, effectively reducing energy consumption, while the microgrid adopts the Dueling DQN algorithm for energy management, enhancing operational efficiency. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method significantly reduces base station energy consumption while increasing microgrid revenue.

articleTitle: Hybrid model for electricity price prediction based on SCINet-GConv-CA
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Fluctuations in electricity price data are often caused by multiple factors, which increases the complexity of forecasting electricity prices and selecting features. To improve the accuracy and reliability of electricity price predictions, a hybrid model based on SCINet-GConv-CA is proposed. Group convolution is utilized to enhance the feature extraction capability of the model and to reduce its computational complexity. The feature transformation module is then used to improve the overall performance and generalization ability of the model, while mining deeper features of the data. Finally, the channel attention mechanism is utilized to enhance the feature expression capability and improve the prediction accuracy. Experiments are conducted on a regional electricity price dataset from Australia and Spain, and the results show that the prediction performance of the model proposed in this paper is significantly improved compared with comparative models such as SCINet.

articleTitle: A Bandpass Frequency Selective Surface With High Selectivity
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In this paper, a five-layer cascaded dual-polarized broadband bandpass frequency selective surface structure is designed and analyzed. The structure is arranged in equilateral triangles, and the top and bottom metal layers are composed of two metal concentric rings combined with a cross-finger structure; the middle three metal layers are composed of two hexagonal patches and a hexagonal ring coupling. The CST simulation results show that the transmission passband of this structure with a transmission loss higher than -1dB covers 8.1-11.76 GHz, and the highest transmission loss in the passband is 0.73dB, and the incidence angle ranges from -45° to 45°, and the 3db rectangularity coefficient is 0.85. The designed FSS structure achieves a broadband bandpass with a frequency selectivity factor of 0.85. The maximum transmission loss in the passband is 0.73 dB, the incidence angle ranges from -45° to 45°, and the 3 dB rectangularity coefficient is 0.85. The designed FSS structure achieves good polarization stability, angular stability, and out-of-band cutoff.

articleTitle: A Color-Aware Unsupervised Segmentation Network for Nuclei in Histopathology Images
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Precise nuclei segmentation is essential in digital pathology, yet it faces difficulties due to the wide existence and morphological diversity of nuclei, staining protocols, and imaging conditions. The process of annotating nuclei instances demands skilled pathologists to carefully trace the outlines of the nuclear structures, which is both labor-intensive and expensive. Consequently, deep learning-based segmentation techniques, which heavily depend on large datasets for training, face challenges in maximizing their effectiveness in this domain. Here our study introduces an unsupervised method for segmenting nuclei instances in whole slide histopathology images. Our approach is divided into two primary phases: self-supervised training and clustering-based segmentation. In the first phase, mask pre-training allows the encoding network to capture the essential color features of pathology images, enabling it to extract more comprehensive and detailed information about the nuclei. In the second stage, the encoder backbone that has been trained is used to derive clustering features from the images. The network learning and clustering processes are optimized jointly, and the final results of instance segmentation are achieved by means of subsequent post-processing techniques. The results indicate that the proposed method exhibits enhanced performance compared to other unsupervised nuclei segmentation approaches.

articleTitle: Knowledge aware intent learning and contrastive learning for course recommendation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In recent years, online education has developed rapidly, providing a vast array of educational resources. Course recommendation algorithms are crucial for MOOC platforms, as they can alleviate the issue of information overload to a certain extent. Due to the cold start problem in recommendation algorithms, researchers have introduced Knowledge Graphs (KG) to address this issue. However, many course recommendation algorithms based on Knowledge Graphs overlook the learning intentions of students when selecting courses, which leads to a decrease in recommendation accuracy. Additionally, the introduction of information such as Knowledge Graphs can bring noise, reducing the performance of the recommendation system. In response to these challenges, We proposes a course recommendation algorithm called Knowledge Graph Intent Network and Multi-graph Contrastive Learning (KGIMCL).This paper delves into the modeling of the interaction intentions between students and courses based on the Knowledge Graph Intent Network, employing attention mechanism strategies to more effectively measure the importance of different relationships within the Knowledge Graph. Furthermore, this paper introduces a novel multi-graph contrastive learning approach. Specifically, it contrasts the course embeddings generated by the Knowledge Graph Intent Network with those generated by the course semantic relationship graph. This contrastive learning strategy enhances the model's performance by reducing the noise introduced by additional knowledge information while incorporating more knowledge into the recommendation system. This paper provides a perspective for MOOC platforms when developing algorithms, considering the learning intentions of students when selecting courses, and reducing the noise that additional information such as Knowledge Graphs might cause in the recommendation system through contrastive learning. The effectiveness of this model is validated on a public MOOC dataset.

articleTitle: Research on Heart Sound Classification Based on SVM Model
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Heart sound is an important physiological signal that is of great significance for evaluating heart function and discovering heart diseases. This article selects 610 sets of heart sound audio from the publicly available datasets of PhysioNet/Cinc Challenge 2016 and PASCAL Challenge. Through wavelet transform denoising and Shannon theory extraction of envelopes, binary processing is performed to obtain key information of heart sounds and extract six characteristic indicators of heart sounds. Finally, these indicators were used as input parameters for machine learning, and SVM algorithm was used to classify heart sound signals, resulting in a total of ten cases with recognition accuracy of over 81.67%. The accuracy, recall, and F1 score of the SVM model are all above 0.7. The results indicate that wavelet transform and Shannon envelope extraction can ensure the quality of heart sound signals and the acquisition of effective features. The SVM model can effectively classify heart sound signals, providing a way to assist clinical decision-making.

articleTitle: Research on Blockchain-Based Insurance Smart Contract Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: With the rapid advancement of blockchain technology, the insurance industry is undergoing significant transformation, and smart contracts offer new possibilities for the automation, transparency, and efficiency of insurance operations. This paper explores blockchain-based insurance smart contract technology by first providing an overview of blockchain and its applications in the insurance sector. It further analyzes the definition, lifecycle, fundamental architecture, and key technological platforms of smart contracts. Subsequently, the paper discusses the applications of smart contracts in process automation, as well as in assessment and pricing. Additionally, a crowdfunding contract system is developed to explore and implement relevant theories of smart contracts.

articleTitle: TCM MLKG-RAG: Traditional Chinese Medicine Intelligent Diagnosis Based on Multi-Layer Knowledge Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) search engines often struggle with the issue of redundant data volumes, making it difficult to meet users' demands for precise information retrieval. Large Language Models (LLMs) excel in understanding questions and summarizing key points due to their vast number of parameters. However, keeping pace with updates in TCM knowledge requires significant computational resources and time for finetuning these large models. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) allows LLMs to generate more accurate, specialized, and timely responses without the need to update their parameters. TCM knowledge is characterized by its dispersed nature and a blend of classical and vernacular language, which makes traditional RAG unsuitable for the field of TCM. To address this, we have developed a TCM knowledge graph RAG that integrates multi-layered knowledge bases, with the lower layer consisting of TCM-specific terminology and explanations, and the upper layer comprising clinical diagnosis and treatment cases. Furthermore, we have proposed two retrieval methods: keyword retrieval and therapy retrieval. Keyword retrieval is designed to search for information on TCM-specific terms, while therapy retrieval locates diseases based on medical and patient information and provides corresponding treatment methods. We have validated the effectiveness of our methods across various datasets.

articleTitle: Optimization of High-Frequency Microstrip Line Fixture and Data Processing based on MWorks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Deembedding is an important means of characterizing high-frequency microwave devices and calibration can help obtain the characteristics of device under test (DUT), thereby achieving the purpose of deembedding. For the same calibration algorithm, the more reliable the fixture performance, the better the calibration effect of DUT, and vice versa. It is worthwhile to study how to obtain high-performance thru-fixture under independent design and limited hardware conditions, as various engineering experiences continue to emerge. The design of microstrip line (ML) calibration fixture under the frequency of 30GHz is taken as the research object and an optimization method of transmission trace structure, which combines the coplanar waveguide with ground (CPWG) as the gradient segment, is proposed in this paper. Simulation results show that ML with CPWG as transition segment can reliably improve the performance of thru-fixture.

articleTitle: Assessment of Radar Target Threats for Side-Blind Areas in Commercial Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Commercial vehicles play a pivotal role in global logistics and transportation, yet they face significant safety challenges due to their size and complex road environments. In this paper, we design a multi-radar fusion system to detect and perceive targets for Side-Bind areas, it effectively improves the accuracy of target detection and reduces the risk of blind spots. Based on the trajectory data from the radar system, threat assessment standards of commercial vehicle have been established for three zones. These standards were developed by analyzing the movement trends of the target and the host vehicle, as well as the states of motion. We can filter targets by calculating the time to collision and distance between the target and the host vehicle. The standards effectively filter potential threat in the blind area, thereby improving the safety of commercial vehicle operation. Compared with the threat assessment that only considers distance, the rationality of these threat assessment standards has been verified by actual measurement data.

articleTitle: Multivariable Reconstruction for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor with Input Filter Based on Extended State Variable
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Active damping is important for using input filters to suppress resonance in permanent magnet synchronous motors (PMSM), but additional sensors are often required. A new multivariate reconstruction (MVR) method is proposed, which is based on the current of inverter and can estimate the current and voltage of the motor with high accuracy and strong robustness, thereby achieving active damping without additional current or voltage sensors. The accuracy and robustness of the proposed MVR in damping systems were tested. Experiment was carried out to test the effectiveness of MVR.

articleTitle: Design of Wideband Filtering Power Divider With Fragment-Type Structure
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In this paper, a compact wideband filtering power divider (FPD) with low loss and high frequency selectivity is proposed. The composite branches, which are composed of lumped elements and short-ended transmission lines, introduce transmission zeros (TZs) on both sides of the passband to produce broadband filtering characteristics, and the coupled lines generate additional transmission zeros to improve out-of-band suppression. A T-type isolation network consisting of a pair of resistors and a short-ended transmission line improves isolation. In order to realize the proposed design concept in a limited space, this paper uses the fragment-type structure (FTS) to implement partial topologies in the FPD. Based on the multi-objective optimization algorithm, the FTS is intelligently optimized and searched, and a compact broadband filtering power divider is designed, the design process is intelligent, and the layout simulation results are consistent with expectation.

articleTitle: SPM Propagation Model Calibration Method and Applicability Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Based on an in-depth study of the urban wireless propagation environment, this paper further refines the relevant parameters of the SPM propagation model using the SPM propagation model itself and its correction algorithm. Through field tests in the Lanzhou area, the model is adjusted and improved by incorporating test data from various types of environments (e.g., urban centres, suburban areas, and mountainous regions), and new SPM model parameters applicable to this area are proposed. A comparison between the calibrated model and the measured data shows that the prediction accuracy of the model is significantly improved, with the average error being considerably reduced across different geographical environments, and remaining within an acceptable range, thereby matching well with the local propagation environment. The findings of this study can provide a more accurate theoretical basis and technical support for the coverage assessment of radio monitoring facilities and the rational allocation of frequency resources.

articleTitle: Lightweight Bird Detection Method for Substation Bird Strike Prevention
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In recent years, with the improvement of the ecological environment and the advancement of power grid construction, the overlap between bird activity areas and substations or transmission lines has been increasing, leading to growing safety risks. To address the issues of traditional bird deterrent methods, which are time-consuming, labor-intensive, and ineffective, a dataset was first constructed by collecting bird images for model training. Next, the PicoDet model was applied to bird detection, and performance evaluation metrics for object detection models were proposed. Finally, the optimized model was validated through inference and compared with the performance parameters of different algorithms. By comparing with commonly used YOLO series object detection models, it was verified that the proposed PicoDet model not only achieves higher detection accuracy but also has the advantages of low memory usage and fast detection speed, making it suitable for high-precision real-time bird detection scenarios in substations.

articleTitle: Automated Security Penetration Testing Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Penetration testing is a crucial measure for preventing cyberspace attacks. Typically, penetration testing is conducted manually, which presents challenges such as reliance on experience, high costs, and low efficiency. This study proposes an automated penetration testing method that integrates machine learning algorithms with Metasploit to achieve low-code generation and execution of penetration testing cases. This approach enhances testing efficiency, reduces costs, and mitigates dependence on experience. The study introduces a decision-making algorithm to facilitate the selection of exploit files during the generation of penetration testing cases and leverages Metasploit to implement basic penetration testing functionalities. Experimental results show that the algorithm achieves an accuracy of 73.16%, and the method successfully meets the objective of automated penetration testing.

articleTitle: Weighted Chaotic Sampling and Frequency Modulation Dexterous Jamming
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In this paper, from the principle of dexterous jamming, the shortcomings of fast attenuation of intermittent sampling and forwarding jamming and strong regularity of periodic waveform convolution modulation jamming are deduced and analyzed. This paper proposes an improved dexterous jamming method based on the combination of intermittent chaotic sampling forwarding and dexterous noise convolution. Firstly, a weighted chaotic sequence is generated, and the characteristics of the chaotic sequence are used to control the sampling so that the distribution of the pseudo-targets does not have a strong regularity, which makes the jamming identification difficult; subsequently, the dexterous noise is used to carry out the convolutional modulation of the sampled signals, which improves the amplitude of the sub-pseudo-targets, and thus realizes the increase of the number of effective pseudo-targets. Finally, by comparing with the classical dexterity jamming algorithm, the effectiveness and correctness of the algorithm is verified in the field of pulse compression radar security attack and defense confrontation.

articleTitle: Progress in the Application of Information Technology in Smart Mines: Research Hotspots and Research Trend
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Information technology is an important technological factor driving the development of smart mines, leading the mining industry towards intelligence, efficiency, and greenness. In order to clarify the integration trend of information technology in the field of smart mining, we conducted a bibliometric analysis of English journal literature and patent literature in the field of smart mining from 2018 to 2023. Analysis has found that the application of multi intelligent robots in mining processes, the application of 5G efficient communication technology in intelligent mines, and intelligent mining under extreme conditions such as deep sea and space are the main research directions of intelligent mines in recent years. The application of multi intelligent robots in mining processes, the application of virtual reality technology in safety training and accident tracing, and the application of neural network algorithms in intelligent mining prediction models are the three research hotspots of information technology in the field of intelligent mining.

articleTitle: Multiobjective Optimization Design of UWB Metal Mesh Transparent Antenna
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: The main challenge for transparent antennas is to enhance the radiation efficiency and gain while maintaining a certain level of transparency. To facilitate the practical application of transparent antennas, the manufacturing process should be mature and cost-effective. We explore a cost-effective form of transparent antenna, namely wired metal mesh (MM). By assigning a design matrix to edges of wired MM, a new design strategy with multi-objective optimization using MOEA/D is proposed. Using this strategy, A UWB transparent CPW feed monopole with 79% transparency and 87% radiation efficiency has been proposed and fabricated. The antenna can be processed using PCB technology, which is very mature.

articleTitle: Design of Integrated Control and Drive Chip for Double-Step-Down Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In this paper, a monolithic integrated DSD converter driver-control chip is designed, which is suitable for the rapid deployment of a DSD converter in the automotive PoL power supply scenario with a 12V/24V bus power supply. The chip integrates the key circuit modules needed for the control of the DSD hybrid converter, which can realize accurate voltage regulation with a high buck ratio and efficient switching and can run stably under different load conditions. The simulation results show that the chip can work at the switching frequency as high as 1 MHz, and the peak conversion efficiency can reach 94.6%.

articleTitle: A High-Performance RISC-V SoC with a DNN Accelerator for Energy Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: As in many applications, the energy sector is witnessing the migration of artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms from the cloud to the edge. This paper introduces a System-on-Chip (SoC) designed for energy control units (ECUs) and data concentrators (DCs) to support edge computing acceleration. The SoC is implemented on the Chipyard platform, utilizing the open-source out-of-order processor BOOM and the software-friendly accelerator Gemmini. Fabricated using a 22nm process, the core achieves a normal operating frequency of 1GHz and occupies a die area of 22.99mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Optimization of GaN HEMT Bridge Topology for Crosstalk Problems
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: With the development of third-generation wide-band semiconductor technology, GaN devices are more and more widely used in the field of power electronics due to their high electron mobility and low on-resistance.GaN devices have lower on-voltage and smaller junction capacitance, so their switching dynamics are affected by the influence of the parasitic parameters, which causes the deadband crosstalk problem in the application of half-bridge circuits. In this paper, GaN-based bridge crosstalk problems are summarized as follows. In this paper, based on the bridge equivalent parasitic circuit of GaN, we introduce the influence of parasitic parameters on the switching process of GaN devices, analyze the reasons for the generation of deadband crosstalk, and propose optimization strategies. From the drive layout level, the drive circuit parasitic inductance is reduced. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed strategies is verified by a double-pulse experimental platform.

articleTitle: Improved Adaptive Wavelet Thresholding Based on Decomposition Layers for Noise Reduction
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In practical application scenarios, sound acts as a vital information carrier. However, the process of sound signal acquisition is frequently perturbed by environmental interferences, causing noise to infiltrate the acquired signals. Hence, noise reduction processing becomes a pivotal aspect of signal processing. The wavelet threshold denoising method is extensively employed in the sound noise reduction realm owing to its simplicity and practicability. In this paper, by integrating the frequency traits of sound information with the characteristics of wavelet decomposition, an enhanced threshold function predicated on the wavelet decomposition layer is devised. Additionally, denoising experiments are executed by appending Gaussian noise of diverse signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs) to pristine sound signals. Concurrently, denoising experiments on speech signals gathered from real scenarios are also performed for comparative analysis. Three evaluation indices, namely SNR, mean square error (MSE), and waveform similarity, are utilized to appraise the performance. Experimental outcomes evince that within specific Gaussian noise environments, in contrast to traditional hard and soft threshold methods, the signal processed by the improved threshold function witnesses an SNR elevation ranging from 10% to 20%, an MSE diminution within 30% - 50%, and a waveform similarity augmentation between 15% and 25%, forcefully demonstrating its preeminent noise reduction prowess.

articleTitle: Node Layout Algorithm Based Environmental Monitoring System for Industrial IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: As the Internet of Things (IoT) technology continues to revolutionize, modern industrial production systems are undergoing profound changes. Current production methods require the expansion of production space to accommodate more equipment, raw materials and workers. The traditional monitoring systems mostly use a simple sensor monitoring method. This kind of monitoring method has the problems of too much monitoring data which is not easy to manage, and the system can not respond in time after the disaster occurs. Based on this situation, this paper proposes a node layout algorithm based industrial IoT environment monitoring system. The system utilizes Zigbee wireless communication technology to construct the network. The master station uses the Loongson 2K1000LA development board as the display and calculation terminal to interact with the cloud platform. The sub-station uses Loongson 1C102 development board as the main control chip to monitor the environmental data. The cloud platform carries out image recognition and sends peripherals control commands. Compared with the traditional monitoring system, this system reduces the peripheral response delay by more than 1.5 seconds, improves the monitoring efficiency by 33%, The peripheral response time difference is reduced by 1.499 seconds, an increase of 61.3%.and facilitates managers to formulate effective security prevention strategies.

articleTitle: Design of photometric absorption ultra-micro volume multi-channel calibration system
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Ultra-micro volume is mainly used in emerging fields such as biopharmaceuticals and genetic engineering. As the main volume measurement carrier in laboratories, pipettes can accurately transfer ultra-micro volume. This project designed an ultra-micro volume optical calibration system based on the principle of photometric absorption, which verified the feasibility of optical methods in the field of ultra-micro volume. A multichannel calibration system was designed. The system mainly consists of an optical system, cascade sample chamber and photoelectric detection system. Through the design and installation of the light source, photoelectric collection circuit and each part of the sample chamber, the function of simultaneous verification of ultra-micro-capacity multi-channel is realized. This design shortens the verification time, improves the verification efficiency, reduces the labor intensity of the operator, and greatly improves the efficiency of the verification. Ultra-micro capacity verification work is of great significance.

articleTitle: Image-to-Image Translation Based on Pre-trained Multi-scale Discriminator
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Image-to-image translation has become a crucial research area, aiming to enable one image to absorb the style of another while retaining its own content. In this research the CycleGAN has made significant strides but is marred by the problem of generating images with inadequate authenticity. This study presents an innovative solution by introducing a pre-trained multi-scale discriminator into the CycleGAN framework. The framework consists of a cycle-consistent network and the discriminator. It projects generated and real images into a pretrained feature space, leveraging advanced semantic features to direct the generator. Multi-scale feature discrimination and a cross-channel mixing strategy in the random projection are employed to comprehensively evaluate image quality and enhance the discriminator's focus on multi-channel correlation features, thereby enhancing the authenticity of the generated images. During the experimental phase, the Cityscapes and Foggy Cityscapes datasets were employed, yielding remarkable results. The generated images exhibit a high level of realism in aspects such as light and shadow, texture, and the overall scene atmosphere. Comparative experiments with CycleGAN evidently demonstrate the superiority of this method in generating more authentic and higher quality images, thereby effectively achieving the conversion between different image domains.

articleTitle: Research on Vehicle Safety Models for Urban Roads
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In this paper, an efficient safety model is constructed for the safety of driverless vehicles on urban roads. By analyzing the current situation of traffic accidents, it points out that weather, geography, and human flow are uncontrollable risk sources. To this end, the model integrates vehicle-road cooperative sensing technology, fuses intelligent decision warning and collision time braking mechanism, and significantly improves road safety. Using Prescan simulation and Matlab cross-validation, the model monitors traffic flow, vehicle status, environmental conditions, and warns of potential risks in real time. Through advanced algorithmic analysis, it evaluates traffic management strategies such as signal light control and speed limit measures to optimize traffic flow and enhance safety. The model can automatically intervene at critical moments to create a safer environment for drivers and passengers, and is widely used in automotive and urban road traffic safety systems.

articleTitle: Integrated Communication and Topology Design for Cross-domain Collaboration between Space and Marine Robots
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: To address the challenge of achieving efficient and flexible communication between space robots and marine robots during cross-domain collaboration tasks, a hybrid communication integration architecture that combines self-organizing networks and satellite internet is proposed to overcome communication barriers. First, the fundamental technologies of self-organizing networks and satellite internet communication, along with their characteristics, are analyzed in detail. Next, the design of the hybrid communication integration architecture is elaborated, focusing on intra-cluster communication, inter-cluster communication, and cooperative communication technologies in conjunction with the ground command center. Simulation results validate the proposed architecture, demonstrating its capability to meet key performance metrics such as low communication delay, high throughput, and high reliability across various tasks. Finally, the potential optimizations and future research directions for this system are discussed, highlighting the need for improvements in real-world adaptability and scalability.

articleTitle: Multi-feature fusion image super-resolution network based on Swin Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: The Swin Transformer-based approach shows astounding performance in lower-level visual tasks such as image resolution enhancement. However, through analysis, we found that some networks have the problem of insufficient ability to model the local information of low-resolution images, resulting in inadequate feature extraction and poor quality of reconstructed images, which implies that we need to do some work to explore the upper limits of the transformer's capabilities as much as possible. In response to these challenges, we propose a novel transformer network called Channel-Space Hybrid Transformer (CSHT), which integrates the attention mechanism while facilitating efficient spatial information extraction. Specifically, the designed algorithm redesigns the Swin Transformer layers, uses the window self-attention in parallel with the channel attention module, and redesigns the Feed-Forward Network (FFN). This fusion strategy enhances the network's representational capabilities, leading to more comprehensive image feature extraction. The redesigned feedforward network we call Spatial Feed-Forward Network (SFFN), a module that mitigates the degradation of feature representation caused by redundant channel information, while effectively capturing spatial information. The proposed method's effectiveness is validated through extensive experiments on public datasets, demonstrating a favorable balance between performance and computational overhead.

articleTitle: Holographic Display of Wavefront Reconstruction Based on Computer-generated Hologram Recordings
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Wavefront reconstruction is a powerful technique for accurately restoring all information about an object, with holography being the most effective method for achieving this. In this paper, we propose a reflective holographic wavefront recording optical system that expands the space-bandwidth product (SBP) using spatial multiplexing technology. This approach enables the recording capacity of holograms that far exceed the display capacity of a spatial light modulator (SLM), and facilitates high-resolution wavefront reconstruction of virtual objects. Using computer-generated hologram algorithms, the wavefront encoding of virtual objects is achieved, and high- resolution holograms are recorded. The holographic reconstruction image displayed on the SLM is passed through a 4f system and used to extract the wavefront information of the object. Experimental results show that under reconstruction light illumination, the holographic plate successfully reconstructs the wavefront and displays the virtual object. The SBP of the reconstructed image significantly exceeds that of a single SLM.

articleTitle: Attention with Mixture Experts model for Multivariate Time Series Imputation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Multivariate time series data often suffer from missing data problems due to sensor failures and environmental impacts, which destroy the integrity of the time series and seriously affect the interpretability of the data. Insufficient long-term dependency capture and difficulty in capturing complex non-linear relationships between multiple features in existing imputation models. To address these issues, we propose an attention with mixture experts model (AME) for multivariate time series imputation. The model consists of two core modules: the diagonal attention based on time bias (DATB) module enhances temporal modeling capability by introducing time bias to capture temporal dependencies; and the mixture of experts (MoE) module selects appropriate expert combinations for different features through routing mechanisms to capture the complex non-linear relationships between features better. We conducted extensive experiments on four real-world datasets, and the results showed that the AME model significantly outperformed the existing five methods in imputation accuracy, validating the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: PM2.5 prediction model based on multivariate feature and frequency information enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In order to improve the prediction accuracy of PM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</inf>, a combined prediction model based on empirical mode decomposition, temporal convolutional network and frequency-enhanced gated attention was proposed. The eigenmode function of PM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</inf> time series is obtained by empirical mode decomposition, and the sample entropy is calculated to distinguish the components of high-frequency, medium-frequency and low-frequency components. The component components are fed into the temporal convolutional network together with other relevant meteorological data to capture the local characteristics and long-term dependencies of the time series. The discrete cosine transform is used to convert the time-domain features extracted by the temporal convolutional network into the frequency domain, and the importance of different frequency components is dynamically evaluated through the attention mechanism. The experimental results show that the EMD-TCN-FEGA combined model is superior to the traditional model in PM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</inf> concentration prediction, and has higher accuracy and generalization ability.

articleTitle: An Information Aggregation and Cellular Automata Based Flood Simulation Method and its Application on Weifang City Urban Area
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In recent years, the frequent occurrence of extreme weather events has put forward higher requirements for the prediction and management of urban flooding. In this study, an information aggregation methods and Cellular Automata flood simulation model based on Caflood-Pro program are suggested, and the flood disaster in the urban area of Weifang City is simulated and analyzed with these model and methodology. The results show that the depth and extent of flooding in the urban area of Weifang City significantly expand with the increase of rainfall return period. The simulation results under different rainfall timescales show that the flood depth and inundation extent show significant differences with changes in rainfall intensity and time.

articleTitle: Greenhouse management system based on multi-node data fusion and visual recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: With the rapid development of smart agriculture, especially in managing greenhouse greenhouses with large areas, the current popular monitoring methods have limitations in their measurements. To make the system monitoring more comprehensive and remote control more convenient, this paper proposes a more integrated system design. This monitoring system uses ZigBee wireless communication technology for data transmission, multi-node data processing through data fusion algorithms, training YOLOv5 model for plant leaf pest and disease identification, uploading data to the IoT cloud platform for storage, and remotely controlling peripherals such as greenhouse lights, windows, and so on through APP. Based on the tomato planting environment for system debugging, monitoring the tomato growing environment and leaf diseases, disease recognition accuracy is about 90%, and farmers can adjust the planting mode in time, to realize science and technology to help farmers.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Refined Management of Military Electronic Component Inventory
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: As modern military equipment becomes increasingly complex and diversified, the role of military electronic components in military systems has grown significantly. Traditional inventory management faces inefficiencies and inaccurate data issues, while intelligent inventory management technologies have significantly improved management efficiency and precision [1] [2]. This paper, based on the characteristics of military electronic components, explores the current state, key technologies, and implementation paths of intelligent inventory management. It focuses on improved measures for storage route optimization and material classification management, proposing a refined management model based on the Internet of Things (IoT) [3] [4], big data analytics [5] [6], and cloud computing [7] [8]. The research provides theoretical support and practical guidance for precise management of military electronic components and ensures operational readiness.

articleTitle: Incorporating Bias in Multi-Penalty Regularization for Improved LF-NMR Data Inversion
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Low-field nuclear magnetic resonance (LF-NMR) detection technology is widely used in the fields of petroleum, materials, etc. due to its advantages such as precision, stability, and non-destructiveness. The collected LF-NMR signal can obtain the relaxation time distribution through inversion technology, realizing sample identification and component analysis at the molecular level. Although the existing regularization method can improve the accuracy of the inversion results to a certain extent, it is not effective in dealing with the problem of data baseline offset. The baseline offset will cause the algorithm to mistakenly believe that the signal has not been completely attenuated, thereby erroneously introducing ultra-long relaxation components. In order to solve this problem, we add a bias term to the traditional regularization term. In the experimental part, we use simulated data and real LF-NMR data to test the proposed method. The results show that the regularization method with the addition of a bias term improves the accuracy of the inversion results while maintaining computational efficiency. Especially in dealing with baseline offset problems, erroneous ultra-long relaxation components can be effectively eliminated.

articleTitle: MDS-UNet: Multi-Dimensional and Multi-Scale UNet for Medical Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Transformer and its variants, along with Mamba and its variants, have found extensive applications in medical image segmentation tasks. However, these hybrid models are often burdened with significant parameter counts and computational demands, which restrict their effectiveness in environments with limited resources. To address this issue, we propose a lightweight medical image segmentation network, MDS-UNet, which integrates the Multi-Scale Receptive Field Fusion Module, Multi-Axis Attention Module, and Multi-Scale Masked Feature Aggregation Module. This design enables the extraction of both global and local features from multiple dimensions and multiple scales, effectively capturing contextual information. The model achieves superior segmentation performance as a lightweight network. The proposed model was validated using the ISIC 2018 skin lesion dataset, and experimental results indicate that MDS-UNet achieves superior performance while substantially reducing the number of parameters to 0.77M and the computational complexity to 1.52 GFLOPs. Specifically, the model attained a mean Intersection over Union of 81.73% and a Dice Similarity Coefficient of 90.32%. Compared to existing advanced models, MDS-UNet exhibits notable advantages in both lightweight design and segmentation accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Question Generation Based on Free-text
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Question generation refers to automatically generating reasonable and relevant questions based on given texts and answers. Past research on question generation has suffered from the following deficiency: in question generation from free texts, the ability to extract semantic information from long texts and answer information is inadequate, resulting in the inability to obtain rich information features. To address this shortcoming, an answer-dependent annotation method was proposed in this paper, which annotates text related to the answer to fully expand the information of the answer in the original sentence and improve the matching degree between questions and answers. Meanwhile, an attention mechanism combining answers and texts was designed in the encoder to enhance answer features by calculating the attention values between answers and texts. A copying mechanism was incorporated into the decoder to strengthen the model's ability to collect text information, improving the quality of questions generated by the model. The method designed in this paper improved BLEU-4 by 0.31% on the SQuAD dataset.

articleTitle: Research on Semantic Segmentation of Remote Sensing Images Based on Improved U-net
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: This study explores the important role of attention mechanism in enhancing the performance of U-Net model for remote sensing image segmentation. By introducing ECA (Efficient Channel Attention) and GACM (Global Attention Context Module), the model performance is significantly improved, as evidenced by the significant increase in MIoU, accuracy and F1 scores.The ECA module improves the MIoU by 6.51 percentage points, the accuracy by 11.84 percentage points and the F1 scores by 14.03 percentage points, respectively, while the use of the GACM module further improved MIoU by 9.11 percentage points, accuracy by 16.03 percentage points and F1 score by 17.73 percentage points. The strategy of combining ECA with GACM results in the improvement of MIoU, accuracy and F1 value by 22.21, 22.84 and 25.71 percentage points, respectively, which proves the complementary nature of the two mechanisms and the potential of the present method in improving the accuracy and robustness of the model, which is of significant practical application value and provides an effective performance enhancement scheme for remote sensing image segmentation.

Author Keywords: semantic segmentation of remote sensing images

articleTitle: A dual-kernel scheduling scheme based on TrustZone
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of the performance of embedded hardware platforms, in the fields of aviation and automotive electronics, an important development direction is to concentrate functions including real-time control, information visualization and human-computer interaction into the same hardware platform. Because of its preemptive design and customized drivers for real-time scenarios, RTOS can meet the requirements of real-time control for hard real-time. However, in terms of the functions related to user experience such as human-computer interaction, the mainstream general operating system (GPOS) such as Windows and Linux is obviously a more suitable choice. In TZDKS architecture, with the help of TrustZone technology under AArch64 architecture, RTOS and GPOS are integrated into the same SoC platform, which can run real-time tasks and common tasks at the same time. However, the Idle scheduling scheme of TZDKS makes the responsiveness of GPOS completely sacrificed when the real-time kernel load is heavy. To solve this problem, this paper uses Sporadic Server algorithm to replace Idle scheduling scheme, and significantly improves the response capability of GPOS while ensuring hard real-time tasks in RTOS.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Power Grid Intelligent Monitoring System Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: The intelligent monitoring system of the power grid is a critical support for ensuring the safe and stable operation of the grid, and enhancing its intelligence level is of great significance. Addressing issues such as low fault recognition accuracy and slow response speed in traditional monitoring systems, this paper designs an intelligent monitoring system for power grids based on deep learning. A layered architecture is adopted to design the system framework, and a CNN-LSTM hybrid network is constructed for fault diagnosis. Additionally, a distributed data processing platform is built on the Spark framework. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed system achieves high fault recognition accuracy and data processing capabilities, significantly shortens warning times, reduces deployment and maintenance costs, and provides a feasible technical solution for smart grid development.

articleTitle: MobileNet-Based Neural Differential Distinguishers for SPECK, GIFT and KATAN
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In 2019, Gohr applied deep learning techniques to differential analysis of block ciphers, pioneering a new direction in differential neural cryptanalysis. Building upon Gohr’s Resnet-based differential-neural distinguisher model, this study further explores the use of various neural network models to reduce model parameter count while maintaining the accuracy of neural differential distinguisher. The work in this paper replaces the ResNet structure with the MobileNet model and incorporates depthwise separable convolution technology, significantly reducing the model’s number of parameters while maintaining high accuracy. Experimental results confirm that, while maintaining low computational costs and reduced parameter counts, the distinguishers presented in this study demonstrate a precision comparable to existing research in the differential analysis of lightweight block ciphers SPECK, GIFT, and KATAN. This provides an effective solution for cryptographic analysis on resource-constrained environments.

articleTitle: An optimization method for point cloud registration based on the rate of point cloud density variation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: An optimization method for point cloud registration combined with the spatial density change rate of point clouds is put forward. This method is utilized to address the issue where the registration optimization process is deviated due to a large number of mismatched point pairs, resulting in the algorithm converging to the wrong position. Adaptive voxel down-sampling is carried out based on the density difference of voxel grids. Mismatched points are filtered through the density change rate. The ratio of the spatial volume change to the point cloud quantity change under different radius coefficient weights is restricted within an appropriate range. This enhances the probability of inner points being selected on the basis of reducing the sampling set, thereby enhancing the accuracy and robustness of point cloud registration.

articleTitle: Research on ARINC653 Two level Scheduling Algorithm and Simulation Method Based on Few Partition Splitting
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: ARINC653 is an important standard for IMA integrated modular avionics systems. In today's rapidly developing world, single core ARINC653 can no longer meet the increasingly diverse tasks and complex systems. Therefore, research on multi-core ARINC653 systems is crucial. This article abstracts the task scheduling of ARINC653 partition system, analyzes the scheduling of ARINC653 multi-core tasks from two levels: inter partition scheduling and intra partition scheduling, and proposes an improved two-level scheduling method. Compared with the traditional ARINC653 scheduling algorithm, this method has fewer partition splitting times. And use AADL modeling language to simulate the system.

articleTitle: A SOC Estimation Method for Lithium-ion Batteries Based on Optuna optimized Long Short-Term Memory Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Estimating a battery's state of charge (SOC) accurately is essential for determining an electric vehicle's safety and remaining range. In this paper, a battery SOC (state of charge) estimation method based on Optuna optimised LSTM is proposed. In response to the problem of low efficiency and difficulty in achieving global optimization through manual parameter tuning in traditional methods, this paper applies the Optuna automated hyperparameter tuning framework and combines it with a random search algorithm to optimize key hyperparameters in the LSTM model. The research results indicate that the optimal setting (Look back: 43, Epoch: 175, Batch size: 65, Learning rate: 0.0029) achieved the best estimation accuracy. Finally, the performance of the model was validated on two different lithiumion battery datasets. The experimental results showed that the LSTM model based on Optuna optimization exhibited good generalization ability and high accuracy under different temperature and dynamic load conditions, significantly improving the reliability and accuracy of SOC estimation.

articleTitle: Research on Efficient Routing Algorithm for Mesh On-Chip Networks Based on Transpose Traffic Pattern
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: The advancement of integrated circuit technology has propelled the development of Network-on-Chip (NoC), with the Mesh structure being widely applied in NoC. In Mesh network structures, the transpose traffic pattern has garnered significant attention due to its ability to balance network loads, reduce network congestion, and enhance resource utilization. This paper proposes a NoC routing algorithm based on the transpose traffic pattern for Mesh network structures. By employing different routing decisions in various regions, the algorithm effectively improves the average network throughput and reduces network latency. Simulation experiments have confirmed that compared to traditional algorithms, this algorithm significantly enhances network performance.

articleTitle: Few-shot action recognition based on optical flow keyframes and hourglass convolution
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Addressing the issues of potential loss of key action information and reduced data utilization efficiency due to current video sampling methods in the field of few-shot action recognition, as well as the inability of traditional feature extractors to fully exploit temporal information in videos, a new few-shot action recognition method based on optical flow keyframes (OFK) and hourglass convolution is proposed. Firstly, an OFK-based sampling strategy is designed to extract the most representative frames from videos, facilitating the capture of dynamic action features. Secondly, an efficient feature extractor (EFE) based on hourglass convolution is constructed, which can extract rich spatiotemporal features while maintaining computational efficiency. Finally, experiments were conducted on three video action datasets: HMDB51, UCF101, and Kinetics, achieving good classification accuracy and demonstrating the effectiveness of each module of the proposed method.

articleTitle: An Optimization Scheme of Cloud Desktop Video Transmission Based on X2Go KDrive Protocol
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Cloud desktop has the advantages of security, easy management, low comprehensive cost, and can meet the needs of mobile office. Cloud desktop based on B/S architecture also has a lot of performance optimization space, in the low-bandwidth network video playback will be stuck, bandwidth usage is too high, response time is too long and other problems. Therefore, this paper proposes a cloud desktop video transmission optimization scheme based on X2Go KDrive protocol, and designs an image block caching algorithm and a hybrid coding algorithm based on video detection. First, the client and the server maintain synchronous image block cache, and then the server detects the video area of the cloud desktop, and adopts H.264 video coding for the image block of the video area and JPEG image coding for the common area. Finally, the mark value of the unchanged image block in the block cache and the compressed data of the changed image block are assembled together to form the final transmission data and sent to the client. After receiving such data, the client can distinguish the unchanged image block and the changed image block, process them respectively, and restore the original image to the screen. The experimental results show that this optimization scheme effectively reduces the network bandwidth occupation during video playback, improves the fluency of video playback, and optimizes the performance of cloud desktop video transmission.

articleTitle: RapidIO-Based Message-Oriented Middleware Design for FPGA Interconnection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Message-oriented middleware is a middleware technology composed of a message-passing mechanism or message queuing pattern, which adopts an efficient and reliable message-passing mechanism for platform-independent data exchange and integrates a distributed system based on data communication. To solve the programming complexity and reliability problems in the interconnection of multiple FPGAs, this paper designs and implements a RapidIO message middleware based on a publish-subscribe mechanism for the FPGA platform. Initially, the system implementation plan is thoroughly researched and designed. Following this, the communication implementation strategy for each FPGA node within the network, along with the publish-subscribe mechanism, is detailed. Finally, the system undergoes comprehensive verification and testing to ensure its functionality and reliability. The test results show that the FPGA message middleware has a bandwidth of up to 1.8GBps and a bit error rate of less than 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−12</sup>, which is suitable for embedded electronic systems with high performance and reliability requirements and has strong application value.

articleTitle: Coordinated Control System Design for Inverters in Distributed Power Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Aiming at the coordinated control problem of grid-connected inverters in distributed generation systems, a control strategy based on distributed algorithms is designed. A 50kW experimental platform consisting of 12 inverters is built to test the system performance. The experimental results show that: the maximum frequency deviation during islanding switching is 0.13Hz, the recovery time is 185ms; the dynamic adjustment time of power is 138ms, the overshoot is 9.2%; the total harmonic distortion rate of the system is 1.85%, and the power factor is 0.995. The control strategy has good dynamic performance and anti-interference ability, meeting the actual engineering requirements.

articleTitle: The Influence of Introduced Channel Attention on Automatic Modulation Recognition Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Automatic Modulation Recognition (AMR) is a signal processing technique for identifying the signal’s modulation type when prior information about the signal is unavailable. AMR technology has broad applications in both military and civilian fields. This study utilizes the widely validated RadioML 2018.10A dataset, which includes more than 24 modulation formats such as On-off Keying (OOK), and trains convolutional neural networks (CNNs) under 26 signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) conditions ranging from -20 dB to 30 dB. To enhance network performance, this study introduces channel attention mechanisms and compare their effectiveness against standard CNNs, residual neural networks (ResNet), and CNNs augmented with the Squeeze-and-Excitation (SE) module. In addition, the author also evaluates the performance of CNN-SE, CNN under varying SNR conditions. Experimental results show that CNNs can maintain 70% accuracy when processing datasets with a 10db signal-to-noise ratio, while RNNs show suboptimal performance across most modulation formats. However, after the introduction of the SE module in the convolutional neural network, it can be observed that the same training effect can be achieved, and CNN-SE requires fewer training rounds. Its network convergence is better, the accuracy rate is up to 80%, and the performance is better under the condition of low SNR.

articleTitle: A Generative Data Augmentation Enhanced Plant Disease Classification Combined Diffusion Model
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: The early detection of plant diseases is of paramount importance for the optimal functioning of agricultural production. However, the performance of models is limited by the amount of data as well as impacted by the imbalance distribution between categories. This study proposes a novel generative data augmentation strategy to enhance classifier performance in plant disease classification tasks. First, elucidated diffusion models (EDM) were proposed to synthesize high-quality synthetic images of grape leaf diseases. This approach effectively mitigates the overfitting and unbalanced problems caused by insufficient data. Secondly, the three pre-train CNN-based models, ResNet50, VGG16, and AlexNet, were employed to classify grape leaf diseases based on the enhanced dataset by combining the generative image. These models effectively capture global features using larger convolutional kernels with overlapping pooling methods and progressively refine these features to extract detailed information from the images. At last, the framework could achieve high performance in classifying healthy grape leaves and three disease types, where the average precision (PR), recall (RE), F1-score (F1), and accuracy (ACC) across four classes were black rot, black measles, healthy and isariopsis leaf spot.This study demonstrated that the generative strategy could enhance the data with a limited amount and sported effective learning in grape leaf disease classification. This novel framework has a high potential for application in the field of plant disease protection and can assist in the development of intelligent agriculture.

articleTitle: Research on Silent Speech Reconstruction Based on the BigVGAN Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: To make the audio of silent electromyographic facial motion speech reconstruction sound smoother, more natural, and realistic, this paper combines the Transformer network with the BigVGAN network and designs a silent speech reconstruction process based on the BigVGAN network. The model extracts features using the ResNet network, then aligns the features through the DTW network before feeding them into the Transformer network to convert the electromyographic signals into an Mel-frequency spectrogram, which is subsequently input into the BigVGAN network for speech reconstruction. The final result is the voiced speech signal corresponding to the silent motion.In addition, this paper also explores the use of the WaveNet decoder and HiFi-GAN decoder for speech reconstruction from the obtained Mel-frequency spectrograms. The experimental results show that the BigVGAN reconstruction network used in this paper achieves a phoneme recognition rate of 90.88%, with a word error rate of 26.1% calculated through the ASR model. Compared to structures such as the WaveNet decoder and HiFi-GAN decoder, the BigVGAN reconstruction network effectively improves recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: User-Centered Design and Implementation of an Intelligent Wearable Device for Real-Time Health Monitoring in IoT Ecosystems
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: This paper focuses on the user-centered design and development of an intelligent wearable device for real-time health monitoring, within an IoT ecosystem. Emphasizing ergonomics, aesthetic appeal, and ease of use, the product design process incorporates human factors engineering and material selection to ensure a comfortable and durable device. The wearable integrates advanced biosensors for continuous monitoring of key health metrics and employs wireless communication for seamless data transmission. A key innovation lies in the integration of machine learning algorithms that enhance the device's predictive capabilities, offering users valuable health insights. This paper outlines the design iterations, prototyping process, and usability testing that led to a market-ready product, ensuring the device meets both functional and user experience goals.

articleTitle: Research on Bird Damage Monitoring Method for Transmission Lines Based on Deep Learning and Sensing Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: This study explores the integration of deep learning and sensor technology for bird damage monitoring along power transmission lines. By combining deep learning algorithms with image, acoustic, and environmental sensors, the system achieves efficient bird species recognition and real-time monitoring, with an accuracy rate of 90%, significantly outperforming traditional methods. The fusion of multi-modal sensor data enhances the accuracy of bird behavior analysis and risk warning, effectively reducing bird damage and improving the stability of transmission lines, thereby enhancing the intelligence of the power system.

articleTitle: Research on Lightweight ER-PBFT Consensus Algorithm for IoT Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: IIoT devices are constrained by energy, computing and communication capabilities, facing challenges such as high energy consumption and long latency. To enhance the applicability of consensus protocols in resource-constrained environments, this paper proposes an improved blockchain consensus algorithm, ER-PBFT, tailored for IIoT scenarios. The algorithm incorporates a node energy model to evaluate energy thresholds and updates node energy values during each consensus preparation phase. On this basis, a reputation score model dynamically adjusts node reputation based on historical behavior, ensuring consensus nodes possess sufficient energy and high reliability. Additionally, a connectivity-based information synchronization algorithm is proposed to establish optimal paths for message forwarding, reducing communication overhead and energy consumption. Experimental simulations show that ER-PBFT outperforms the traditional PBFT protocol in terms of consensus latency and energy consumption. When the number of nodes reaches 50, ER-PBFT reduces latency by approximately 73.27%, increases throughput by about 34.53%, and decreases energy consumption by approximately 79.29% compared to traditional PBFT.

articleTitle: Spatial-Temporal Traffic Forecasting Based on Optimized Dynamic Graph Convolutional Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Traffic forecasting stands as a pivotal element within intelligent transportation systems. Achieving precise traffic forecasting presents a formidable challenge, primarily due to the latent correlations inherent in traffic network and the non-Euclidean characteristics of traffic data. Despite the proposition of numerous spatio-temporal modeling methodologies, they continue to demonstrate constraints in extracting intricate spatio-temporal features from traffic data and capturing their underlying spatio-temporal correlations. Furthermore, the extraction of spatial features is significantly contingent upon the configuration of graph representation structures. A preponderance of methods relies on either predefined or adaptively generated graphs, yet none of them can accurately mirror the authentic relationships among nodes. To tackle these intricacies, this paper introduces the Optimized Dynamic Graph Convolutional Network (ODGCN) for spatio-temporal traffic forecasting. The ODGCN primarily comprises a dynamic graph construction methods and optimized graph convolutional layers. The innovative model uses a novel dynamic graph structure generation method to construct the sensor adjacency matrix as a basis for extracting dynamic spatial features in the transportation network. The optimized graph convolutional layers proficiently capture intricate dependencies among nodes while preserving graph structural information through the utilization of stacked 1D convolutional components. An in-depth analysis conducted on two traffic datasets collected in the real world underscores the superiority of ODGCN in comparison to the most advanced baseline methodologies.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic MPPT Algorithm Based on Improved Gray Wolf Optimizer for Partial Shading Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: When photovoltaic arrays operate under partial shading conditions (PSC), the output power-voltage (P-V) curves may exhibit nonlinear and multi-extreme characteristics, reducing the power conversion efficiency. More robust intelligent optimization algorithms for maximum power point tracking (MPPT) are necessitated. However, existing MPPT algorithms suffer from slow convergence speeds, a tendency to get trapped in local extrema, and low tracking accuracy. This paper proposed an MPPT control method based on an improved grey wolf optimizer (IGWO). The algorithm introduces a piecewise adjustable attenuation factor to balance the search range in the early and late stages of the algorithm. Additionally, to address the multiple extrema issue under PSC, the algorithm incorporates the Lévy flight strategy to enhance global search capability. Moreover, a random perturbation strategy is introduced to strengthen local exploration and improve the tracking accuracy. Extensive experimental results under various PSCs demonstrate that the proposed IGWO-based MPPT algorithm achieves a minimum tracking time of 13 ms and a maximum tracking accuracy of 99.93%. Compared to various benchmarking algorithms, the proposed method offers shorter tracking time and higher accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Multimodal Fusion Target Motion Trajectory Prediction Algorithm Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Trajectory prediction for moving targets is a key technology in fields such as intelligent manufacturing, autonomous driving, and video surveillance. This paper proposes a Deep Multimodal Fusion Trajectory Prediction (DMFTP) algorithm based on deep reinforcement learning for multimodal fusion target motion trajectory prediction. The algorithm establishes a multimodal trajectory prediction model with an attention mechanism to reduce the information loss and difficulties in modeling in multimodal fusion target motion trajectory prediction. Tested on multiple datasets, the results show that the algorithm has certain advantages over existing technologies in terms of accuracy and robustness. The research in this paper aims to provide a feasible solution for target motion trajectory prediction in complex environments.

articleTitle: Measurement of Liquid Nitrogen Mass in Dewar by Radio Frequency
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: With the wide application of liquid nitrogen in industrial manufacturing, liquid nitrogen metering based on dewar has become a focus of attention in the industry. In the past, the metrology of liquid nitrogen still remained at the stage of liquid level measurement, and no extensive research has appeared for the accurate measurement of liquid nitrogen quality. In this paper, for the measurement of liquid nitrogen quality inside dewar, an experimental system is built based on RFMG technology. Vector network analyzer with faster sweep is used to measure the return loss of the port, and the principle of this technology for liquid nitrogen quality measurement are analyzed. A numerical model of resonance frequency and liquid nitrogen filling ratio is established by simulation calculation, and then the numerical model is compared with the experimental data. It is found that the nonlinear error between the measured value of this technology and the simulated numerical model is 1.4%. RFMG has a broad prospect in the industrial application of liquid nitrogen, and it can realize the accurate measurement of the quality of liquid nitrogen in the dewar in the place of the traditional liquid level meter.

articleTitle: Integrated Circuit Fault Diagnosis Model Based on Multilayer Perceptron
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: The traditional fault diagnosis methods in particular often fail to meet the needs of fast and accurate diagnosis for contemporary electronic devices. This paper attempts to study a fault diagnosis model based on multilayer perceptron. First, a large amount of circuit test data and fault samples are collected, and the data is cleaned and standardized to ensure data quality. Then, the input feature vector is constructed, including parameters such as voltage, current, and temperature. Next, multilayer perceptron is modelled, where activation functions such as ReLU and Softmax are implemented for nonlinear mapping.
