The model is trained using the back propagation algorithm, where weights and biases are optimized to reduce the mean square error. The performance of the model is evaluated with cross-validation, and its accuracy is further improved through hyperparameter setting regarding learning rate and batch size. The model reaches 95.2% accuracy in fault diagnosis, and the average diagnosis time is reduced by 30%. The multilayer perceptron-based fault diagnosis model has come out to be a superb ally in enhancing the performance of integrated circuit fault diagnosis and providing strong support for reliability in electronic equipment.

articleTitle: Π-shape Gate Structure Design for MOS Combined with p-GaN AlGaN/GaN HEMTs
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: GaN as a typical third generation wide-bandwidth semiconductor material is widely used in various power devices and sensor devices. However, depletion devices are conventional GaN-based HEMTs, and in practical applications, additional negative gate voltage is usually required to turn off the channel, which leads to an increase in system power consumption, for this reason enhanced HEMT devices need to be developed. In order to enhance the functionality of enhanced GaN-based HEMTs, Al- GaN/GaN hetero structured HEMT with Π-shape p-type gate GaN combined with MOS structure is designed in this paper. A comprehensive analysis was carried out to compare the output characteristics, transfer characteristics, transconductance and breakdown characteristics of the devices with those of common p-type GaN gate structure AlGaN/GaN HEMT devices. The results show that the hybrid structure of Π-shape p-type gate and MOS is able to increase the current density, the on-resistance is reduced, which greatly improves the output current of the device, but the break down voltage is almost equal, in addition, the gate control of the channel is enhanced at almost the same threshold voltage.

articleTitle: Optimizing Multi-Task Learning for Enhanced Performance in Large Language Models
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: This study aims to explore the performance improvement method of large language models based on GPT-4 under the multi-task learning framework and conducts experiments on two tasks: text classification and automatic summary generation. Through the combined design of shared feature extractors and task-specific modules, we achieve knowledge-sharing and optimization of multiple tasks in the same model. The experiment uses multiple subtasks of the GLUE dataset to compare the performance of the multi-task model with the single-task GPT-4, the multi-task version of GPT-3, the BERT basic model, and the classic Bi-LSTM with Attention model. The results show that the proposed multi-task learning model outperforms other comparison models in terms of text classification accuracy and ROUGE value of summary generation, demonstrating the advantages of multi-task learning in improving model generalization ability and collaborative learning between tasks. The model maintains a stable loss convergence rate during training, showing good learning efficiency and adaptability to the test set. This study verifies the applicability of the multi-task learning framework in large language models, especially in improving the model's ability to balance different tasks. In the future, with the combination of large language models and multimodal data and the application of dynamic task adjustment technology, the framework based on multi-task learning is expected to play a greater role in practical applications across fields and provide new ideas for the development of general artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: Compass Alignment Error Compensation Method for Underwater Vehicles in Inshore Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: It is using Doppler velocity to assist the compass alignment that solves the speed error problem in the compass alignment. The vehicle acceleration also leads to the compass alignment error. When the underwater vehicle works in the nearshore environment, it is seriously disturbed by the rapid change of current line acceleration, which will produce greater compass alignment error. In order to further improve the compass alignment accuracy, the influence and compensation of the underwater vehicle linear acceleration on compass alignment has become an urgent issue for inshore underwater compass alignment. Based on this background, the compensation method of the compass alignment of the inshore underwater vehicle is proposed. Firstly, the influence mechanism of linear acceleration on compass heading error is studied, and the compensation method of compass linear acceleration error based on Doppler velocity difference is analyzed. Finally, the error data reflecting the error characteristics of the doppler velocity log is extracted from the actual measurement data of the doppler velocity log, superimposed on the velocity truth value to generate semi-physical data, and the proposed method is verified by semi-physical simulation. The experimental results show that the maximum value of heading angle oscillation is reduced by about 96% after adopting the method proposed in this paper, and the time to converge to steady state again decreases from 300-400s to 200-250s. The data processing results show that the linear acceleration obtained by the DVL velocity difference compensates for the linear motion acceleration in the compass control loop, reduces the violent oscillation of the compass alignment result, and improves the heading alignment accuracy of the nearshore underwater robot.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of External Interrupts in Machine Mode for RISC-V Architecture Processor
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Interrupt mechanism is the key to the design of processor hardware. This paper introduces the design and implementation of external interrupt system of RISC-V processor, focuses on the discussion of platform-level interrupt controller (PLIC) and the special interrupt processing module inside the processor, analyzes the interrupt request (IRQ) processing flow, through the optimized interrupt processing module, Improves the response speed of the system to interrupt requests. At the same time, RISC-V related instructions are used for simulation verification on Vivado platform.

articleTitle: Analysis of JPEXIT Decoding Thresholds for DP-LDPC Based on Global and Separating Strategies
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Double Photograph LDPC Codes (DP-LDPC) demonstrate superior Bit Error Rate (BER) performance in Joint Source-Channel Coding (JSCC) systems compared to Source-Channel Separation Coding systems. To analyze the theoretical performance of DP-LDPC codes, this paper employs Joint Photograph Extrinsic Information Transfer (JPEXIT) chats as a tool for performance assessment. We design both global strategy and separating strategy JPEXIT for decoding threshold analysis. The results indicate that the decoding thresholds of the global strategy and separating strategy JPEXIT are nearly equal under the same joint base matrix. Additionally, the time complexity of both strategies is the same. However, from the perspectives of code implementation complexity and program execution time, the global strategy JPEXIT is more advantageous.

articleTitle: A Novel Recognition Algorithm of Human Micro-motion by Using Continuous Wave Radar
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Human micro-motion can affect the detection of cardiopulmonary signals. To recognize the interference of human micro-motions, a 24 GHz continuous wave (CW) radar is utilized to collect signals of different micro-motions. The recognition is performed based on time-frequency features extracted by a short-time iterative adaptive approach (STIAA). STIAA can obtain a higher resolution compared to conventional short-time Fourier transform (STFT). Based on the time-frequency features, the transfer learning technique with pre-trained convolutional neural networks is applied to recognize five human micro-motions. The experiment results demonstrate that the performance of the proposed scheme is promising.

articleTitle: Dipolar spin wave properties excited by a perpendicular magnetic anisotropy magnetic waveguide
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Spin waves, a collective magnetic precession phenomenon, offer promising potential for advanced microwave signal processing. This study investigates spin wave propagation in La: YIG thin films, where the waveguide structure itself is designed with perpendicular magnetic anisotropy (PMA) to optimize microwave signal transmission. A 100 nm thick La:YIG film was grown on a GGG substrate using liquid-phase epitaxy (LPE), and coplanar waveguide (CPW) antennas were fabricated using photolithography and magnetron sputtering. Spin wave transmission was characterized via a vector network analyzer (VNA), measuring two modes: Magnetostatic Surface Spin Waves (MSSW) and Backward Volume Magnetostatic Waves (BVMSW). The results reveal that the PMA-based waveguide significantly enhances spin wave propagation, with MSSW mode achieving superior microwave bandpass filtering performance (4.9 dB insertion loss) compared to BVMSW mode (16.5 dB). Moreover, the calculated group velocity in the MSSW mode was 0.864 km/s, 72.8% higher than that of pure YIG, demonstrating the crucial role of PMA in enhancing device performance for microwave signal processing.

articleTitle: Design of U Band SIW Filter Based on TGV Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: With the rapid development of wireless communication technology, microwave filters are facing increasing performance challenges Substrate-integrated waveguide (SIW) has attracted much attention in the field of microwave filter design due to its advantages of low insertion loss, high Q and excellent integration. However, the design and fabrication of conventional SIW filters are often constrained by conditions such as material selection and processing technology. In this paper, based on the glass through-hole (TGV) technology, we constructed a 3D encapsulated electromagnetic simulation model of the TGV using 3D electromagnetic field simulation software, deeply analyzed the characteristics of the TGV under high-frequency signals, and obtained the simulation results of the S-parameters, which demonstrated excellent high-frequency performance. On this basis, we designed a glass dielectric integrated SIW bandpass filter operating in the frequency band from 39.50 GHz to 41.5 GHz with a size of only 6 mm × 2 mm × 0.3 mm. The filter achieves S21 greater than -3 dB and S11 less than -12 dB within the band with excellent performance.

articleTitle: Research on Flood Risk Prediction Model Based on K-means and AHP-CRITIC Weighting Method
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: This study first used Pearson correlation analysis to examine the relationship between various indicators and flood occurrence, identifying the top ten most relevant indicators: “monsoon intensity,” “sedimentation,” “landslides,” “deforestation,” “agricultural practices,” “climate change,” “policy factors,” “population score,” “wetland loss,” and “urbanization.” Based on these indicators, a flood risk prediction model was constructed. The K-means algorithm was used to classify flood probabilities into three categories: “high risk,” “medium risk,” and “low risk.” The AHP-CRITIC method was applied to weight each indicator, and the weighted data was used to train a random forest model. The model’s hyperparameters were set to "n_estimators = 200," "random_state = 42," and "criterion = gini." Cross-validation with K-folds resulted in an average score of 0.531 and a standard deviation of 0.000434, indicating good robustness. Compared to existing models, the proposed model showed improvements in accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score, and it demonstrated good generalizability through validation with data from multiple regions and climatic conditions. Sensitivity analysis revealed that indicators such as “monsoon intensity” and “landslides” had the greatest impact on the model’s predictions, providing important insights for model optimization.

articleTitle: A Compact Flexible CPW-fed Circular Monopole UWB Antenna with Full Ground Plane Structure
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: A compact flexible Coplanar waveguide fed (CPW-fed) circular monopole ultra-wideband (UWB) antenna with full ground plane structure is proposed for wireless body-area network (WBAN) applications. A metal parasitic circular patch is introduced between the radiating element and the ground plane to extend the bandwidth. Multiple independent resonances are created by incorporating parasitic structures like semi-ring parasitic patch, semi-ring slots, via-hole to the mid-layer, and L-shape slots to further improve the impedance matching performance in the whole frequency range. The antenna uses denim as substrate to ensure good flexibility and wearing comfort. It has an overall size of 80×65×4.255 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> (0.755λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> × 0.613λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> × 0.04λ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> at the lowest operating frequency). The simulation results show that the proposed antenna has an operating frequency band of 2.83-10.88 GHz, and it has unidirectional radiation patterns with a highest realized gain of 7.35 dBi at 9.47 GHz. Due to the full ground plane structure, the antenna has minimized interference on human bodies, with a SAR value as low as 0.25 Watt/kg, proving to be a good candidate for WBAN applications.

articleTitle: Design of a Gate-Diode LVTSCR with High Holding Voltage and Robustness
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: A gate-diode LVTSCR(GDLVTSCR) is proposed and implemented in 0.18um CMOS technology. By embedding a gate-diode in the traditional LVTSCR, an additional surface discharge path is provided, thereby enhancing the holding voltage and robustness. Transient simulations of the device were carried out using TCAD, the turn-on process and working principle of the device were analyzed. The simulation results demonstrate that the gated diode path can discharge the large ESD current together with the main SCR. The TLP test results demonstrate that compared with traditional LVTSCR, the proposed GDLVTSCR has a lower |V|<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">t1</inf>, a higher |V|<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">h</inf>, and a greater failure current.

articleTitle: Base Station Deployment Scheme for Low-Altitude Integrated Sensing and Communication Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) is a key technology of future fifth-generation-advanced (5G-A) and sixth-generation (6G) mobile communication systems. The low-altitude ISAC network is a typical application of ISAC. To ensure the sustainable development of the low-altitude economy, establishing proper deployment scheme is essential. The existing research on ISAC networks deployment is inadequate, mainly concentrating on coverage performance analysis. This paper proposes a base station (BS) deployment scheme for low-altitude ISAC networks based on both theoretical derivations and measurement results, which can provide guidance for future practical deployment of ISAC networks.

articleTitle: FPGA-Based High-Precision Pulse Signal Detection Unit for Large-Scale Scientific Experiments
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: With the increasing demand for high-precision time measurements in the field of high-energy physics, Time-to-Digital Converters (TDCs) have become important measurement tools widely used in scientific research such as particle physics and nuclear physics. Traditional TDC implementations usually rely on Application-Specific Integrated Circuits (ASICs), but their high cost and long development cycles have made FPGA-based TDC systems a research focus. This paper presents a high-precision FPGA-based TDC system that combines coarse counting and fine measurement structures. By employing code density testing and bit-by-bit calibration methods, the system significantly enhances time measurement accuracy and stability. The system utilizes the UDP protocol for data transmission and employs a Gigabit Ethernet interface for high-speed data exchange. Experimental results show that the designed TDC system achieves a time resolution of 13.44ps, with low RMS error (17.34ps) and small nonlinear errors (DNL and INL ranges of [-0.99, 1.08] LSB and [-2.27, 2.31] LSB, respectively). This TDC system holds great potential for applications in high-energy physics experiments and particle accelerators, providing high-precision time interval measurement support.

articleTitle: Design of ID card recognition system based on OCR and STM32 microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of long entry time and high error rate of manual information collection, an ID card information collection system based on Optical Character Recognition (OCR) technology and STM32 was designed. The system uses STM32F103C8T6 and STM32H750XIT6 as the control core, through the control of OV5640 image collector to collect the ID card picture, and then through the microprocessor distortion correction algorithm to preprocess the picture, the processed picture data is transmitted to the host computer developed by C# language by USB serial port protocol. Finally, the image data is transmitted to the connected Baidu AI open platform through the upper computer and then receives the returned data, and then further decodes, displays the results to the upper computer interface, or automatically exports text and table data. Through the test, the system can effectively automate the whole process of ID card information acquisition and export, the hardware system to capture the image pixel is QVGA(320x240), the average time is about 1.6s, the identification is accurate and convenient, has a certain reference significance for modern intelligent office, cost reduction and efficiency.

articleTitle: Design of a Level-1 Data Cache for the Processor Based on Single Instruction Multiple Threads
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: This paper presents the design and Verilog implementation of a Level-1 data cache targeting the high-concurrency memory access requirements of a custom-instruction-set SIMT architecture processor. By introducing a multi-bank architecture and a row interleaving strategy, consecutive cache lines are distributed across different banks, effectively exploiting data locality among concurrent threads in the SIMT processor. The design of the Miss Status Handling Register (MSHR) supports non-blocking execution in the custom-instruction-set SIMT processor, adopting content-addressable memory and dual-issue two-stage pipelines. In Verilog RTL simulation tests based on convolutional neural network workloads using the custom instruction set, the data cache consistently reduces data transfer latency and improves overall processor performance across various configurations.

articleTitle: YOLOv8-CAFMFusion for Image Segmentation of Substation Operation Elements in Complex Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: This paper presents an enhanced segmentation method for substation operation elements, leveraging YOLOv8 integrated with the Content-Aware Fusion Module (CAFM) from HCANet. The proposed model aims to address the challenges of detecting safety violations in complex and dynamic substation environments, where objects often overlap or are occluded. By incorporating a content-guided attention fusion mechanism, the model captures both global and local contextual information, significantly improving pixel-level segmentation accuracy. Experimental results demonstrate that the YOLOv8-CAFMFusion model achieves a 3.2% improvement in mAP (from 79.3% to 82.5%) and a 17.2% reduction in inference time (from 29 ms to 24 ms). This enhanced performance enables more accurate and real-time detection of safety violations, such as improper use of protective gear or unauthorized access to restricted zones. The use of image segmentation for substation operation monitoring offers significant advantages over traditional object detection, including precise identification of object boundaries and better handling of occlusions, ultimately contributing to a safer and more efficient operational environment.

articleTitle: Multi-convolution Module Fusion Network for Object Detection Based on 3D Point Cloud
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: The existing lidar data has the characteristics of sparsity and rotation invariance, which affects the effect of the algorithm in downstream tasks.Aiming at the problem of sparse point cloud data target detection, this study improves the PartA2 model and proposes a Multi-convolution module fusion network. By improving the Refconv module and combining the EMAC module, a serial structure backbone network is proposed to optimize the feature extraction effect of the original backbone network. Through experiments, the private data set in the garage environment has good visual performance. For vehicles, pedestrian 3D indicators are increased by 1.2 % and 1.5 % respectively compared with the original model. The BEV index of bicycle objects with high detection difficulty is increased by 1.3 %, and the 3D index is increased by 1.6 %.

articleTitle: Improved Whale Optimization Algorithm with Multi-Strategy Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of poor initial population diversity, slow convergence speed and easy to fall into local optimization of traditional WOA algorithm, a whale optimization algorithm improved by multi-strategy fusion is proposed. First, the initial population is improved by using Latin hypercubic sampling method to make the initial solution distribution more uniform; then, the local search ability of the algorithm is improved by introducing adaptive weights, and the global search ability of the algorithm is enhanced by combining the Lévy flight strategy; finally, the Cauchy variation is introduced to enhance the ability of the algorithm to jump out of the local optimum. Through optimization experiments on 13 benchmark functions, the results show that the whale algorithm improved by multi-strategy fusion has obvious improvement in both the search accuracy and convergence speed.

articleTitle: Multidimensional Robustness Evaluation in Text Matching Models
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: With the rapid development of NLP technology, text-matching models have been widely used in several fields. Still, their vulnerability in the face of small changes in input data or malicious attacks has become a focus of attention. In this study, a comprehensive robustness index (RI) is constructed by multi-dimensional robustness assessment using metrics such as robustness radius, attack success rate (ASR), and performance loss rate (PDR), and the model is extensively perturbed and tested using tools such as TextFlint. The experimental results show that the accuracy of the model decreases on the standard test set. Still, the multi-dimensional robustness assessment effectively reflects the robustness performance of the model in specific application scenarios through the constructed comprehensive robustness index (RI), which provides a thorough assessment framework for identifying model weaknesses and optimizing them.

articleTitle: Testing and Research of Electrical Characteristics during Operation for High-Speed Interface of Contact IoT Card
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: This paper studies electrical characteristics’ test methods for high-speed interface of contact IoT card based on the latest national standard, which high speed interface supports 20MHz input clock and highest real-time transmission rate can be up to 2.5Mbps. This paper mainly analyzes and evaluates current consumption of the IoT card during ATR and current consumption of the IoT card during the session at maximum frequency of high speed IoT card based on different supply voltages.

articleTitle: Encryption upgrade method for vehicle terminal firmware based on improved AES algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: With the rapid popularization of intelligent vehicles, the security of vehicle terminal firmware in the process of remote upgrade is becoming more and more important. To this end, two improvement measures are proposed to enhance the security of the firmware upgrading process: firstly, the key expansion in the traditional AES algorithm is improved, and a random function is used to generate the first-round key and optimize the round key expansion algorithm; secondly, a new key transmission method is proposed to enhance the security of the transmission process by using the dynamic insertion of the key technology. Experiments have shown that the combination of these two methods significantly improves the security of the firmware during the upgrade process without reducing the encryption efficiency.

articleTitle: Automatic Test Cases Generation Based on State Machine Diagram of Systems Modeling Language
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: This paper presents a method for automatically generating effective test cases based on SysML state diagrams. The method firstly obtains Systems Modeling Language (SysML) state diagrams described in XML format, using Document Object Model to parse the model information. Secondly, the Finite state machine (FSM) is chosen as the intermediate transformation model, during which concurrent and composite states are processed. Based on this, test paths are generated using the All Transitions (AT) algorithm and the Modified Condition/Decision Coverage (MC/DC) algorithm. Test data are created using constraint-solving methods, ultimately leading to the output of effective test cases.

articleTitle: Identifying Money Laundering Risks in Digital Asset Transactions Based on AI Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: This paper explores methods for detecting suspicious cryptocurrency transactions associated with money laundering, leveraging advanced AI algorithms. The study introduces a multi-model framework combining Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), LSTM, Autoencoder-Based Anomaly Detection Model (ABAD), and other algorithms to address challenges like sample imbalance and noisy data. Graph-based feature engineering and embedding methods are utilized to construct transaction information graphs and extract meaningful patterns. The results demonstrate that the ensemble learning approach significantly outperforms individual models and traditional rule-based systems in detecting suspicious transactions. Despite its success, challenges such as imbalanced datasets, noise, and limited relational features remain. Future research is suggested to enhance model performance through graph neural networks and complex network-based methods. This work underscores the scalability and adaptability of machine learning models for addressing the evolving complexities of cryptocurrency money laundering.

articleTitle: A Feasibility Study on Containerization of Traditional Embedded Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: With the arrival of information technology and the increasing popularity of electronic devices, a large number of embedded devices rush into the new production or modern engineering fields. These computing devices are working alone without a centralized use of computing power. The emergence of container technology makes the deployment and execution of applications more efficient, and the scope of migration and distribution is becoming more and more extensive. How to apply container technology to traditional embedded systems to improve the efficiency of application deployment is worth thinking. In this paper, we analyzed the characteristics of three embedded systems with the features of container technologies., and summarized the efforts needed to be made for the containerization of embedded systems. We proposed a prototype of container manager and validated the design on an existing embedded system by implementing a simple progam to parse the bundle and execute container applications. The result shows that our design can conform to the OCI specification and execute user processes correctly on the current embedded system.

articleTitle: Dynamic Scheduling Strategies for Resource Optimization in Computing Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: The rapid development of cloud-native architecture has promoted the widespread application of container technology, but the optimization problems in container scheduling and resource management still face many challenges. This paper proposes a container scheduling method based on multi-objective optimization, which aims to balance key performance indicators such as resource utilization, load balancing and task completion efficiency. By introducing optimization models and heuristic algorithms, the scheduling strategy is comprehensively improved, and experimental verification is carried out using the real Google Cluster Data dataset. The experimental results show that compared with traditional static rule algorithms and heuristic algorithms, the optimized scheduling scheme shows significant advantages in resource utilization, load balancing and burst task completion efficiency. This shows that the proposed method can effectively improve resource management efficiency and ensure service quality and system stability in complex dynamic cloud environments. At the same time, this paper also explores the future development direction of scheduling algorithms in multi-tenant environments, heterogeneous cloud computing, and cross-edge and cloud collaborative computing scenarios, and proposes research prospects for energy consumption optimization, adaptive scheduling and fairness. The research results not only provide a theoretical basis and practical reference for container scheduling under cloud-native architecture, but also lay a foundation for further realizing intelligent and efficient resource management.

articleTitle: Research on Recognition Method of Infrared Dim Small Flying Targets Based on Multi-layer LBP Features
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: This paper proposes a method that combines the pre-trained VGG19 model with the local texture description method of Local Binary Pattern (LBP) to improve the feature description performance of infrared dim small targets. Specifically, LBP texture features are extracted from the outputs of 16 convolutional layers of the VGG19 network, using Mean LBP to enhance robustness to image brightness changes caused by the impact of atmospheric environmental. For recognition, a framework based on sparse representation theory is employed. This includes dictionary learning, sparse coding, classifier training, and target classification. The Orthogonal Matching Pursuit (OMP) method is used for sparse coding, and Support Vector Machine (SVM) is adopted as the classification model. The proposed method is evaluated using a dataset simulating four types of aerial targets under four typical meteorological conditions. A total of 1143 images are generated through simulation, and the five-fold cross-validation method is used to assess performance. Finally, the classifier achieves an average precision of 81.34%.

articleTitle: Intelligent Vehicle Positioning Method Based on UWB and GPS Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: This paper proposes an intelligent vehicle positioning method based on the fusion of UWB and GPS, which achieves high-precision positioning through the Kalman filter combined with the weighted filtering algorithm. Experiments were conducted on a 1:12 scale off-road vehicle model, and a football field was selected as the test site to compare the positioning errors under the single GPS mode, single UWB mode, and GPS&UWB fusion positioning mode. The results show that the fusion positioning method can reduce the drift deviation generated by the system during continuous operation and improve the navigation stability. This method provides an active exploration for the unmanned driving navigation system, and realizes point-to-point transportation positioning at the lowest cost without using radar mapping for obstacle avoidance and reconstructing transport vehicles.

articleTitle: Broadcast Link Prediction Method for Heterogeneous Networks Based on Homogeneous Subgraph Partitioning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In recent years, the application of graph neural network methods to heterogeneous networks has emerged as a research focus. The link prediction task is one of the most crucial tasks in the domain of complex networks. Heterogeneous networks simultaneously possess complex structural information and diverse semantic information, thereby presenting substantial challenges for link prediction in heterogeneous networks. To this end, this paper proposes a broadcast link prediction approach based on homogeneous subgraph partitioning (Metapath Partitioned Broadcast Link Prediction, MPBLP). Specifically, the original heterogeneous network is initially partitioned into homogeneous subgraphs with distinct semantics through meta-paths. Secondly, within each homogeneous subgraph, broadcast message passing is carried out for the target node pair (u, v) to acquire the information of the paths between node pairs. Finally, the embedding representations in different homogeneous subgraphs are weighted and aggregated via an attention mechanism to obtain the final representation of the node pair and accomplish the link prediction task. Experiments conducted on multiple public heterogeneous network datasets indicate that the MPBLP method proposed in this paper significantly surpasses the existing baseline methods in terms of link prediction accuracy, demonstrating the effectiveness and theoretical value of this method in the field of heterogeneous network link prediction.

articleTitle: Dueling Bandits with Constant Regret Bound Using Causal Intervention
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: The causal dueling bandit problem is to solve the following task: given a causal graph with an unknown distribution where the reward variable is implicit, in each round, there are two actions (interventions) to be taken independently to the graph and the learner subsequently observe the outcome of the preference of the two actions though reward is unobservable. The goal is to minimize regret of the interventions. We propose a new framework for causal dueling bandits that can efficiently utilize relative feedback. In our framework, the learner updates the upper confidence bound using causal knowledge, and applies a UCB-based dueling algorithm to select arms for comparison. We propose two algorithms, Causal Relative Upper Confidence Bound (C-RUCB) and Causal Max Informative Pair (C-MaxInP), which proved to enjoy constant high probability regret and expected cumulative regret in terms of the instance parameters. We empirically demonstrate that our algorithm outperforms other baselines on synthetic data.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization Strategies of Load Balancing Algorithms Based on Spring Cloud Alibaba
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: The microservices framework has become a mainstream framework for software development both domestically and internationally,It has high maintainability, wide scalability, and freedom of technology stack have been universally recognized by users. However, the quality of load balancing in microservices directly affects the execution efficiency and robustness of the entire software. Based on the Spring Cloud framework and in combination with components developed by Alibaba, this paper analyzes existing allocation strategies, pointing out the shortcomings of static allocation strategies when dealing with heterogeneous clusters or sudden situations. Leveraging Redis caching,A dynamic load balancing algorithm based on computer state implementation is proposed. Experimental results demonstrate that this method can improve the allocation balance in near-limit allocation states while maintaining the same allocation lower limit as static load balancing.

articleTitle: Research on data-driven continuous casting billet quality prediction modeling approach
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: The unreasonable use of process control procedures and composition ratios in the continuous casting production process will have an extremely bad impact, resulting in low steel qualification rate, smelting process energy consumption and other serious problems. In response to the above problems, a continuous casting billet quality prediction model is established from the causes of continuous casting billet quality defects, incorporating data-driven. The process parameters corresponding to the two continuous casting billet qualities, AQ0E1 and DV0A1, were first preprocessed using data cleaning and dimensionality reduction methods. A data-driven approach was adopted to establish a continuous casting billet quality prediction model using shuffling frog leaping algorithm (SFLA), genetic algorithm (GA) and BP neural network to form a hybrid evolutionary neural network (HENN) continuous casting billet quality classification prediction model. The prediction accuracy of AQ0E1 and DV0A1 can reach 88.33% and 90.38%, respectively. The model in this paper has higher accuracy and good stability than traditional methods, the continuous casting billet can be accurately predicted, it is convenient to quickly trace back to the cause of defects in continuous casting billet, and it has a certain guiding significance for the development of intelligent continuous casting industrial production.

articleTitle: A Miniature Low-Power Environmental Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: With the advancement of technology and the acceleration of modern industrialization, the application fields of environmental monitoring technology are constantly expanding. However, in specific scenarios, such as locations with limited space or those difficult to access frequently, traditional environmental monitoring systems face challenges, particularly the inconvenience of power replacement. Therefore, designing a miniature low-power environmental monitoring system is of significant practical importance. This paper uses the STM32L412CBU6 as the core controller, combined with various sensors such as the CCS811 gas sensor, SHT20 temperature and humidity sensor, and OPT3001 light intensity sensor for data acquisition. The data is transmitted to the main controller and sent to the cloud platform via an NBIOT communication module, enabling remote data transmission and monitoring. While meeting monitoring requirements, this paper selects low-power devices and designs corresponding low-power control strategies. By optimizing software control, the system's operating duration is extended by approximately 10 days compared to traditional solutions. In addition, this paper applies the environmental monitoring system to movable cultural relic monitoring, tracking parameters such as gases, temperature and humidity, and light intensity around the relics. The feasibility of the system design is verified through testing in actual application scenarios.

articleTitle: Design of a 2D and 3D Situation Display Platform Based on WebGL and Modern Web Technology Stack
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: This paper aims to discuss and introduce a comprehensive situation display platform built on WebGL and modern Web technology stack and its implementation process. Based on the unified information service standard specification, the platform completes the integration and organization of various types of data with multi-source, heterogeneous, and decentralized storage. It provides users with rich geographic information services and an immersive data visualization experience. This paper describes the system architecture, technical features, and the realization of functional modules of the platform in detail, which reflects the advantages of using geographic information efficiently and improving user experience.

articleTitle: Feature extraction of gamma spectra based on a CNN-GRU fusion classification model
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: The development of nuclide recognition methods based on marine gamma spectra is crucial for enhancing the performance of radiological monitoring. Marine gamma ray spectra often exhibit significant fluctuations and noise, complicating the measurement and identification of nuclides. Existing methods include denoising, background subtraction, and feature extraction. During these processes, information from low-count channels may be lost. This study proposes a CNN-GRU fusion classification model. To ensure the model's effectiveness and generalization capability, the training dataset was constructed based on both marine field experiments and laboratory standard source experiments, as well as Monte Carlo simulations. The study compares a 2D-CNN model, a 1D-GRU model, and the CNN-GRU fusion classification model. Model performance was evaluated using metrics such as F1 score, recall, precision, accuracy, and loss curves. The results demonstrate that the CNN-GRU fusion classification model not only performs well in identifying drift peaks and weak peaks but also extracts more detailed information from complex spectra, showing significant improvements in both accuracy and algorithm efficiency.

articleTitle: Design and Research on Remote Sensing Monitoring Platform for Smart Sugarcane Fields
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: This paper addresses the technical problems of remote sensing technology in modern sugarcane cultivation, in terms of growth monitoring, pest and disease monitoring and meteorological monitoring, using remote sensing technology such as high altitude satellite, radar and UAV to obtain hyperspectral image data, and using MODIS-NDVI algorithm, support vector machine and linear regression algorithm, we conducted research on the height of sugarcane plants, identification of healthy and affected areas of sugarcane, and prediction of precipitation, to achieve the Remote sensing monitoring platform on sugarcane cultivation to accurately obtain the meteorological status, accurately judge the growth stage of sugarcane, and timely detect the threat of sugarcane pests and diseases. Data simulation experiments were carried out by applying MATLAB software, and the experimental values were accurate and reliable, and the results showed that the adopted technical methods are practical and feasible in the construction of remote sensing monitoring platform for intelligent sugarcane fields, which provides effective technical support for the scientific management of sugarcane planting.

articleTitle: An Efficient Power Management Circuit for Battery Monitoring Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: With the growing adoption of renewable energy sources like wind and solar power, energy storage systems are vital for balancing supply and demand and ensuring grid stability. Lithium-ion batteries, known for their high energy density, long cycle life, and rapid response, are widely used for energy storage. However, they operate under challenging conditions, including frequent charge-discharge cycles and fluctuating temperatures, which can impact performance and safety. This paper presents an advanced Power Management Circuit (PMC) to improve efficiency and extend battery life. The proposed solution integrates dynamic zero-tracking compensation for LDO regulation and dynamic switching adjustment to reduce switching losses under light loads. The PMC, with an input voltage range of 1.9V–3.3V, offers adjustable output voltages (1.7V–1.9V and 0.8V–1.0V) and achieves over 85% efficiency. Experimental results demonstrate significant improvements in efficiency, stability, and battery lifespan for lithium-ion energy storage systems.

articleTitle: Low-Noise Front-End Amplifier Design for 10Gbps Optical Receiver
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: A critical performance metric for optical receiver is sensitivity which is limited by noise. In optical receivers, achieving a low-noise front-end amplifier while maintaining bandwidth is a challenge. This challenge arises due to the trade-off between bandwidth and noise. This paper proposes a circuit design to break this trade-off using a two-stage cascaded circuit. Noise is solved by using a shunt-feedback transimpedance amplifier (TIA) with big feedback resistor and the bandwidth limited by TIA will be compensated by continuous-time linear equalizer (CTLE). The circuit simulation achieves a transimpedance gain of 82dB, a -3dB bandwidth of 7.6GHz, and an input reference noise of 0.27μA, meeting bandwidth and low-noise requirements in optical receiver.

articleTitle: CDWNet: An Efficient and Lightweight Classification and Object Detection Algorithm for Construction and Demolition Waste
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: To address the challenge of effectively classifying and recycling construction and demolition waste (CDW), this study proposes a lightweight object detection algorithm, CDWNet, based on YOLO11. The model constructs a Global Context-Aware Detection Head (GCADHead) and a Hierarchical Enriched Feature Aggregation Network (HEFAN), and introduces the lightweight convolution module GSConv. Experimental results demonstrate that CDWNet achieves high accuracy and efficiency in waste classification under complex scenarios, significantly reducing the number of parameters and computational costs while improving performance. This study provides an effective solution for deployment on resource-constrained edge devices, contributing to the automation of CDW classification.

articleTitle: Fusion of Deep Learning and Adaptive Networking for UAV Swarm Communication Performance Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: A distributed management system for multi-UAV swarm networks is designed based on mobile ad hoc networks. The system features a hierarchical architecture with dual-mode wireless communication and edge computing units. Through optimized protocol stacks and management algorithms, the system demonstrates stable performance in a 30-node swarm test. Results show successful dynamic topology reconstruction with end-to-end delay under 18.5ms and network throughput of 875Mbps, offering a reliable solution for UAV swarm management.

articleTitle: Study and Analysis of Propagation Characteristics of the Ionospheric
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In long-wave and short-wave communication, in order to meet the needs of long-distance communication, the ionosphere is often used to propagate the reflection characteristics of low-frequency electromagnetic waves, so as to achieve the communication outside the visual distance, therefore, the study of the ionosphere propagation characteristics is very important. In this paper, the author first gives the derivation process of the equation of motion of microscopic charged particles in the ionosphere, and combined with the existing literature, calculates the electrical characteristic parameters of the ionosphere during the propagation of low-frequency electromagnetic waves.

articleTitle: High Frequency Channel Optimization Based on Institute of Telecommunication Science Model
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: The high frequency ionospheric channel has the characteristics of multipath effect, fading, Doppler frequency shift and Doppler broadening. The characteristics of the ionosphere vary with time and position, which has a great influence on the shortwave signal transmitted through the ionosphere. The ITS model is a classical model based on the measured data to describe the shortwave channel. It is not only suitable for narrowband signals but also for broadband signals. Its accuracy is higher than the general channel model, but its implementation requires a large number of measured parameters. The curve of the power delay spectrum function in the ITS model is close to the Nakagami function curve under certain parameters. Therefore, by studying the Nakagami function, the ITS simulated power delay profile function under the minimum error can be simulated to optimize the ITS model.

articleTitle: A Fine-Grained Access Control for User Carbon Emission Data Based on Spatio-Temporal Attribute-Based Encryption
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: With the rapid growth of user carbon emission data, data privacy and confidentiality have become critical concerns. To protect the critical and sensitive information of users, access control serves as one of the fundamental solutions. This paper proposes a novel fine-grained access control method, combining blockchain and spatio-temporal attribute-based encryption to enhance data security. In this approach, blockchain provides decentralized, distributed storage and verification mechanisms, while spatio-temporal attribute-based encryption is used to implement access policies specified by the data owner. By integrating spatial and temporal characteristics into the encryption process, the proposed method ensures that only authorized entities can access sensitive carbon emission data at designated times and locations. Experimental results demonstrate that this method effectively maintains data confidentiality while providing flexibility and scalability for access control in blockchain environments.

articleTitle: An Optimization Study of a Mechanism-Assisted Hybrid Neural Network Prediction Model
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: The primary airflow of a boiler is a crucial parameter that influences the efficiency of combustion and the potential for energy savings. Conventional prediction techniques are ill-equipped to handle intricate nonlinear and time-varying relationships, making precise forecasting a formidable challenge. This paper proposes a hybrid model combining CNN, LSTM and Attention mechanism, with the objective of improving the accuracy of predictions regarding primary airflow. The model employs a three-stage process. Initially, CNN is used to extract local features. Subsequently, LSTM is employed to model temporal dependencies. Finally, an attention mechanism is used to focus on key features. In order to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method, experiments were conducted using historical data from a 600 MW thermal power unit in a power station. A variety of comparative experiments were carried out, which demonstrated that the proposed model exhibited superior prediction performance compared to traditional LSTM and CNN-LSTM models in the test set, with an R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> value of 0.95 and an RMSE of 3.1. Moreover, the model demonstrates remarkable performance in fast-varying and oscillating regions, offering a valuable tool for optimizing boiler operations and advancing industrial intelligence.

articleTitle: Comparative study of model-driven development and SQL control
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: With the growing demand for efficient code generation and maintenance in software development, model-driven development and SQLcontrol development have gradually become important choices in modern enterprise applications. This paper focuses on JDL (Jhipster Domain Language) in JHipster and MyBatis-Plus, comparing their core technical features in data model generation, database interaction, development efficiency, and applicable scenarios to analyze the advantages and disadvantages of these two development models. Through experiments, this paper evaluates the performance of JDL and MyBatis-Plus in terms of development efficiency, code maintainability, and system performance, while further exploring how to leverage the strengths of both frameworks in mixed development scenarios to address complex project requirements. Experimental results show that JDL is better suited for rapid development and highly automated, standardized scenarios, while MyBatis-Plus excels in handling high complexity and fine-grained control requirements. This paper summarizes the applicable scenarios of these two development models and their combined usage, providing developers with detailed technical guidance for technology selection and offering recommendations for optimizing future database development tools.

articleTitle: The Broadband Equivalent Circuit Model of the Coil and the Parameter Calculation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In non-sinusoidal operating scenarios, the broadband coil equivalent circuit model is essential for analyzing the operational state of devices or systems. This paper develops a circuit model consisting of multiple resistors, inductors, and capacitors, which accurately fits the impedance characteristics of the coil over a wide frequency range. The broadband model is applied to fit the impedance curves of four different types of coils, and its accuracy and effectiveness are validated through comparison with experimental measurements. Finally, circuit experiments are conducted to further verify the model's applicability and reliability in practical circuit implementations.

articleTitle: Efficient rPPG-Based Biometric Authentication Using Lightweight Vision Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Biometric features such as face representation and heartbeat signals from ECG are widely used for authentication. However, the existing biometric authentication systems still have defects, face recognition is susceptible to attacks such as replaying and generating videos, while ECG signals are contact detected, limiting their applications. In this study, a face video authentication technique based on rPPG is proposed. Firstly, we analyzed the facial distribution specificity of rPPG and confirmed its feasibility for identity authentication. After that, we proposed preprocessing the video data into an MSTMap, which contains both heart rate information and its facial spatiotemporal distribution, for classification. Finally, we used a lightweight Vision Transformer (ViT) for feature extraction, and to address the issue of limited training data, we employed Masked Autoencoders (MAE) for pretraining. The final algorithm achieves 97.64% accuracy, 4.33% FAR, and 4.34% FRR.

articleTitle: A Universal Model for Waveform Design of Integrated Communication and Navigation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Traditional communication and navigation systems are typically designed independently, utilizing different frequency bands without integration for combined applications. However, both systems operate on the transmission of radio signals, which provides a natural advantage for their integration. This paper a universal model for the design of the ICaN waveform, which incorporates a theoretical framework and considers trade-offs in resource allocation, which aims to optimize the performance of both communication and navigation systems in typical application scenarios. Communication performance is assessed in terms of data transfer rate, while navigation performance uses the merit factor (MF). Through theoretical analysis and numerical simulation, relying on the Single Carrier Frequency Domain Equalization (SC-FDE) system the feasibility, effectiveness, and engineering implementation of the universal model are validated, enabling optimal integration of communication and navigation in typical application scenarios.

articleTitle: A digital multi-channel system based on parallel full comparison baseline restoration method
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: This paper designs a baseline estimation digital energy spectrum measurement system using a parallel full-comparison method, aimed at reducing the impact of baseline drift on the energy resolution of the digital energy spectrum measurement system. The system consists of two parts: an analog baseline adjustment circuit and a digital baseline estimation module. The digital module first performs baseline estimation, then transmits the results to the frontend circuit to adjust the baseline, thereby correcting drift caused by circuit noise and signal pulse stacking. The system is mainly composed of a DAC baseline adjustment circuit, an ADC sampling circuit, and an FPGA-based digital multi-channel analysis system, in which a parallel full-comparison mean baseline estimation method is deployed to calculate the baseline adjustment amount. To verify the reliability of the system, NaI detectors were used in this study, and the energy resolution and response of the system were tested using dual-source <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">137</sup>Cs and <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">60</sup>Co. The experimental results show that the linear response fitting of the digital multi-channel energy spectrum measurement system exceeds 99.99%. Under high counting rates, the energy resolution without baseline recovery was 8.83% (@0.662 keV), while the energy resolution with the parallel full-comparison baseline recovery method was 7.57% (@0.662 keV), improving by 0.92%. In conclusion, compared to the system without baseline recovery, the parallel full-comparison baseline recovery method effectively alleviates the baseline drift issue of the NaI detector under high counting rates, thereby improving the energy resolution of the system.

articleTitle: SFFNet: Multi-Scale Sparse Focus Feature Cue-Aware for Efficient Facial Expression Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Facial expression recognition is an important subtask in the field of computer vision. Accurate recognition of facial expressions plays a critical role in applications such as human-computer interaction, emotion analysis, and intelligent surveillance. In this work, we propose a novel approach for learning multi-scale sparse focus features by combining CNN and Swin Transformer architectures, which enables the effective capture of both local and global patterns in facial expression images. Additionally, we introduce two key modules: Adaptive Hierarchical Feature Construction (AHFC) and Dual Contextual Attention Synthesis Unit (DCASU). Specifically, the AHFC module leverages Swin Transformer to extract multi-scale facial expression features while mining the relationships among sparse focus features. The DCASU module, on the other hand, extracts local features and utilizes attention mechanisms to focus on crucial regions of the face. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on the RAF-DB (89.18%) and KDEF (95.81%) datasets, validating the effectiveness and superiority of our approach.

articleTitle: A Physical Information Neural Network Algorithm for Centroid Solution of Cross Strip Anode Detector
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: With the rapid development of aerospace technology, the detection ability of remote dim target has become a key task. Cross strip anode (XS) photoelectric imaging detector can be used to capture weak target signal, has become a powerful tool for remote target detection. Due to the complex and changeable space environment, various noises will inevitably enter the detection system, thus interfering with the accurate detection of targets and reducing signal resolution. In order to improve the precision of calculating the centroid of cross strip anode under strong noise, a model based on physical information neural network (PINN) is proposed. Compared with the traditional centroid method, the physical information based neural network method does not need to set specific parameters according to the type of noise, so it is hardly affected by noise interference and can obtain high precision centroid localization.

articleTitle: Offshore ship classification based on Mel-frequency Cepstral Coefficients of main intrinsic mode
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Recognition of ship-radiated noise is essential for advancing ship automation, marine resource exploration, and underwater operations. This study presents a novel recognition method for ship signals that integrates the variational mode decomposition (VMD) with Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients (MFCC). The method decomposes ship-radiated noise into the intrinsic mode functions (IMFs) and selects the top IMF that predominantly contributes to the signal's energy, which is then used to extract the MFCC of the ship-radiated noise signals. The extracted MFCC features are used to recognize different ships with the support vector machine (SVM). The experimental results show that this method achieves an average recognition rate exceeding 98% for the three types of ship-radiated noises across ShipsEar database. The proposed VMD-MFCC-SVM (VMS) not only enhances the recognition of ship signals, but also offers a promising approach for the identification of ship signals, highlighting its substantial potential for practical applications.

articleTitle: C&C Encrypted Traffic Detection Based on Business Baseline Model and Joint Similarity
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: This study proposes an encrypted traffic detection method based on a business baseline model and joint similarity. First, by extracting network traffic features, a business baseline model for normal traffic is constructed, and support vector machine (SVM) is used for classification to determine whether the traffic is normal or anomalous. Additionally, the study introduces the joint similarity method to further improve the accuracy of encrypted traffic detection. Joint similarity combines multi-dimensional features and calculates the similarity between traffic flows to detect anomalous traffic that deviates from the overall pattern. Experimental results show that the SVM-based business baseline model performs well in encrypted traffic detection, and when combined with the joint similarity method, the detection accuracy improves significantly, achieving the detection of over 99.9% of encrypted traffic. This method effectively addresses the challenges of encrypted traffic detection in traditional traffic analysis and has high practical value and potential for wider application.

articleTitle: TSP path planning based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In recent years, the proposal and development of algorithms have been accelerating, and algorithms with various purposes, principles, simplicity, complexity, and sources have been applied to difficult problems. Whether it is new algorithms or the optimization of existing algorithms, the corresponding algorithm performance is getting better and better, such as genetic algorithm. At the same time, the TSP path planning problem is also a common problem that people encounter in daily life. In order to obtain the optimal value of the path, this paper proposes a TSP path planning method based on genetic algorithm. This method first generates 100 simulated city points; Then, using Python language and following the principles of genetic algorithm and the entire process, data was used as parameter input for 2000 loop iterations. During this process, the total path continuously decreased, and finally a path starting from the starting city point, passing through 100 city points, and finally regressing to a total of 8.4967 starting points was obtained. This simulation test further verifies that genetic algorithm is capable of optimizing TSP path planning, and its performance is also excellent, which can be promoted and used.

articleTitle: A Moving Object Detection and Tracking Framework Based on YOLOv8 Model and Improved OC-SORT Algorithm in Complex Marine Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Moving target detection and tracking is an important application field of Marine detection, which can provide important support for maritime safety and monitoring maritime search and rescue, maritime traffic management and optimization and civil surveillance. Compared to conventional methods for detecting and tracking moving objects, deep learning-based approaches can achieve higher accuracy in complex Marine environments. The complex environment at sea usually includes changing light conditions, waves, reflections, etc., which have a great impact on traditional methods, and deep learning models can learn these complex features through a large number of training data, so as to improve the recognition and tracking ability of targets. This paper proposes a moving object detection and tracking framework based on YOLOv8 model and improved OC-SORT algorithm. First, the performance of YOLOv8 models of various sizes in detecting objects is evaluated to select the most appropriate model for multi-target motion detection in complex marine environments. Then, an enhanced OC-SORT algorithm is employed to track the detected targets, thereby completing the entire detection and tracking procedure. The experimental outcomes demonstrate that this framework not only boasts high accuracy in both detection and tracking but also possesses the capability for real-time tracking.

articleTitle: Low-Power, High-Precision Signal Distortion Measurement System Based on MSPM0G3507
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: This paper presents a low-power, high-precision signal distortion measurement system based on the MSPM0G3507 microcontroller. The system addresses the issues of high power consumption and limited integration found in traditional signal distortion measurement instruments. By utilizing amplification circuits, on-board ADC sampling, and digital signal processing, the system accurately measures the total harmonic distortion of the input signal by analyzing the fundamental frequency and harmonic components using fast Fourier transform. With a relative error of less than 3% for signals in the 30mV to 600mV range and distortion levels between 5% and 50%, and an operating current of less than 200μA, the system offers a compact, energy-efficient solution for signal processing, communications, and audio analysis applications. The design is highly integrated and precise, with potential for a wide range of applications in low-power environments.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Channel Weak Current Quasi- Synchronous Measurement Technology Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Based on the current demand for real-time detection and reading of the size and spatial distribution of the extracted beam by negative ion sources, this paper proposes a multi-channel weak current quasi synchronous measurement scheme based on FPGA. The capture of the beam passing through the Faraday cup array is converted into a micro weak current array with spatial position relationship, which is then converted into a voltage signal through a conditioning amplification circuit and collected through a high-precision ADC chip, Finally, the reconstruction of multi-channel weak current is completed on the host computer. The experimental results indicate that based on this scheme, accurate measurement of 10μA-120μA ampere weak current can be successfully achieved.

articleTitle: A Multi-Feature Fusion Approach for ECG Signal Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Arrhythmia is a typical condition in cardiovascular diseases, posing a serious threat to patients' health. Electrocardiogram (ECG), as an effective tool for detecting arrhythmia, plays a crucial role in diagnosing the condition through automatic classification. However, most existing ECG classification methods focus on extracting features from time-space domain signals, often overlooking the significant value of frequency-domain information. This study proposes a novel ECG signal analysis method aimed at integrating time, space, and frequency domain features. Specifically, we first utilize multi-scale dilated convolutional modules to capture and fuse spatial features at different scales. Next, we introduce a frequency-domain perception module to extract the frequency-domain characteristics of ECG signals. To further enhance the interaction between time-space features, a bidirectional inversion mechanism is introduced to generate forward and backward sequences for both spatial and frequency domain features. These are then deeply fused through a bidirectional self-attention mechanism, enabling comprehensive extraction of contextual information. Experimental results show that, the proposed feature fusion strategy significantly improves the recognition ability of ECG signals, demonstrating high robustness and potential for application.

articleTitle: Design of Fabrication Error-Tolerant Microstrip Directional Coupler
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In this paper, an error tolerance design technique is proposed and demonstrated by 28GHz microstrip directional coupler. By including the tolerance requirement of PCB fabrication errors as one of the objective functions, multi-objective optimization searching for the optimal fragment-type structure of the directional coupler can be implemented to acquire both high performance indices and high error tolerance. Design and test of 10-dB directional coupler operating at 28 GHz band on PCB of area of 2.54mm×5.76mm indicates that return loss of 24dB, directivity over 25dB in an operation bandwidth of approximately 22% can be acquired. In addition, the coupler has almost the same fabrication error tolerance as the microstrip coupler operating at the 2 GHz band.

articleTitle: Research on a Multi object Tracking Model Based on Bayesian Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In response to the problems of weak timeliness and large errors in traditional algorithms in complex scenes, a Bayesian based multi-target tracking model (BFMTT) was designed by introducing the theory of random finite sets and combining it with probability hypothesis density filters. This model effectively addresses the tracking of targets in environments with varying numbers of targets, occlusion, and clutter. The results indicate that the model has significant advantages in tracking accuracy and real-time performance for multiple targets in complex scenes.

articleTitle: MGHA: Multi-Granularity Hierarchical Aggregation for Knowledge Graph Embedding
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Knowledge Graph Embedding (KGE) involves embedding entities and relations from a knowledge graph (KG) into continuous vector spaces, learning the representations of entities and relations while preserving the inherent structure of the KGs. However, current research in KGE focuses primarily on learning global representations, with relatively little attention paid to effectively modeling complex relational heterogeneity and capturing interdependencies across different scales. This results in challenges when attempting to model multi-level, cross-scale feature fusion. To address this issue, we propose Multi-Granularity Hierarchical Aggregation for Knowledge Graph Embedding (MGHA). This method employs a multi-granularity hierarchical encoder for global context extraction and local structure encoding, enabling feature modeling from the global to the local level and effectively capturing cross-scale information. Building upon this, the model introduces a channel attention mechanism to adaptively weight the aggregated features, thereby achieving hierarchical fusion of multi-granularity information and ultimately generating embedding features that simultaneously represent both global and local information. Experimental results demonstrate that MGHA achieves competitive results on four widely-used benchmark datasets.

articleTitle: A Fast Shape Filling Algorithm for Multi-layer PCB
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: With the increasing integration of printed circuit board, traditional methods are unable to meet the requirements for size and weight. Copper plating, a crucial step in PCB design, plays a significant role in improving the performance and effectiveness of PCB. To address the numerous features on large scale multi-layer PCB, a fast shape filling algorithm is proposed. This algorithm utilizes graphic information classification. The core idea of the algorithm is as follows: firstly, a large number of features are divided into regions based on their graphical information. Then, clustering is performed based on collision relationships. The outer contour chains are obtained based on the clustering results. Finally, the result is obtained through the relationship between the contour chains. The algorithm is implemented in a Windows 10 environment with a 2.30 GHz processor and 16 GB memory, and industrial test data is used to validate its performance. The experimental results demonstrate that compared to an open-source copper plating tool based on fitting polygons, the proposed algorithm is independent of the number of polygon edges and achieves a time improvement of approximately 60%.

articleTitle: Research on 5G Communication Control Strategies for Autonomous Driving
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
