abstract: This paper expounds the construction of an autonomous driving wireless communication system, underscoring the pivotal function of 5G technology in providing high bandwidth and low-latency communication, as well as the advantages of edge computing in data processing and response time reduction. It introduces a multi-path data forwarding strategy that intelligently selects data transmission paths through URL parsing. This strategy, combined with an enhanced SF-RED algorithm and end-to-end dual-connection dual-link technology, effectively reduces packet loss. Furthermore, an optimized task allocation strategy for 5G edge access nodes is proposed, aimed at efficient task delegation and maximizing system utility through reduced execution duration at edge access nodes. Empirical results show that the proposed strategies significantly enhance communication quality, response speed, and control accuracy within autonomous driving systems, thereby offering strong support for the development of autonomous driving technology.

articleTitle: PC-Yolov7: An Algorithm for Maritime Object Detection Based on Yolov7
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Maritime object detection is vital for surveillance, management, and safety at sea. Traditional methods often fail in complex marine environments, causing detection errors. To address this, the PC-Yolov7 model was developed, based on Yolov7. It features a Coordinate Attention mechanism for better small object detection, a Partial Convolution module for faster feature extraction, and an optimized SPPFCSPC pyramid pooling module for improved field coverage. The model also uses Normalized Wasserstein Distance to boost accuracy in detecting small objects. Tests show PC-Yolov7 achieves a 92.8% mAP0.5, a 1.7% increase over Yolov7, with fewer parameters, lower computational requirements, and faster detection speeds. This highlights PC-Yolov7's superior performance in maritime detection tasks.

articleTitle: Cultivated land parcel recognition method based on deeplabv3+ semantic segmentation model for high-resolution unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) imagery
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: The contemporary means of extracting arable land parcels based on semantic segmentation often neglects the fine-grained features of the parcels, which is poorly effective in dealing with irregularly shaped parcels, and is prone to the condition that the boundaries are not sufficiently clear and definite. To address the above problems, this study takes Xing'an County and Lipu County in Guilin City, Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region as the study area, and builds its own dataset of cropland plots, and proposes an improved deeplabv3+ semantic segmentation model for accurately extracting cultivated land parcels from mountainous UAV imagery, which employs MobileNetV2 as the backbone network, introduces the CBAM attention mechanism and the DFF dynamic feature fusion module, so that the extracted contour boundaries of cultivated plots more accurately. The improved deeplabv3+ model achieves 87.19% MPA and 80.36% MIoU in the extraction of cultivated plots. Comparison experiments with the deeplabv3+ and PSPNet models showed that the prediction accuracy of the improved model was better than that of the above two models, in which the MPA increased by 4.05% and 8.86%, and the MIoU increased by 5.62% and 10.17%. The extracted cropland plots are more consistent with the actual distribution pattern of cropland than the existing methods, which provides a practical method to accurately extract cropland information from irregular plots.

articleTitle: Personalized Recommendation User Experience in Tourism Digital Products: A Case-Based Reasoning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: The study examines the delicate balance between personalization and user privacy in tourism digital products, focusing on personalized recommendation systems. While the extensive use of user data to create tailored recommendations enhances user experience, it also raises significant concerns regarding privacy and data security. To address these challenges, this research evaluates the effectiveness of various models—Differential Privacy, Federated Learning, Homomorphic Encryption, Data Minimization, and Case-Based Reasoning (CBR)—in balancing privacy protection and personalization. Among these approaches, CBR emerges as the most effective. By leveraging historical user cases, CBR minimizes the need for extensive data collection, ensuring strong privacy safeguards while enabling adaptive learning and personalized recommendations. Additionally, it promotes transparency, empowering users to understand and control how their data is utilized—a crucial factor in building trust within the tourism sector. A comparative analysis of the five models, using survey data, reveals that CBR outperforms its counterparts in three key areas: data privacy protection, personalization effectiveness, and user transparency. CBR consistently achieves the highest mean scores across these criteria. Statistical analysis further confirms the significance of these differences, with CBR explaining the largest portion of the variability in effectiveness scores. This research underscores CBR’s potential as the optimal model for developing privacy-conscious and user-centric recommendation systems in tourism digital products. Its implementation could drive future innovations in the industry, aligning technological advancements with user trust and satisfaction.

articleTitle: Enhancing Recommendation Systems with GNNs and Addressing Over-Smoothing
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: This paper addresses key challenges in enhancing recommendation systems by leveraging Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and addressing inherent limitations such as over-smoothing, which reduces model effectiveness as network hierarchy deepens. The proposed approach introduces three GNN-based recommendation models, specifically designed to mitigate over-smoothing through innovative mechanisms like residual connections and identity mapping within the aggregation propagation process. These modifications enable more effective information flow across layers, preserving essential user-item interaction details to improve recommendation accuracy. Additionally, the study emphasizes the critical need for interpretability in recommendation systems, aiming to provide transparent and justifiable suggestions tailored to dynamic user preferences. By integrating collaborative filtering with GNN architectures, the proposed models not only enhance predictive accuracy but also align recommendations more closely with individual behaviors, adapting to nuanced shifts in user interests. This work advances the field by tackling both technical and user-centric challenges, contributing to the development of robust and explainable recommendation systems capable of managing the complexity and scale of modern online environments.

articleTitle: Dynamic Reward Shaping with State-Action Feedback for UAV Control
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: The application of reinforcement learning in UAV control has made significant progress, especially in autonomous navigation and task execution in complex environments. However, traditional reward design and algorithms often face issues such as sparse rewards and low training efficiency. To address these challenges, this paper proposes an improved method for UAV heading control tasks. The proposed State-Action Based Reward Augmentation (SARA) algorithm utilizes state and action information from historical trajectories to precisely evaluate the impact of each decision point on task performance, while incorporating Beta distribution to provide additional reward signals to the agent. A dynamic trajectory clearing mechanism is introduced to improve the real-time calculation of rewards and reduce computational overhead. Additionally, the k-nearest neighbors (KNN) method is used to dynamically adjust the Beta distribution parameters, further enhancing the accuracy of the reward signals. These improvements not only enhance the performance of the algorithm in UAV tasks but also provide new insights into the application of reinforcement learning in control tasks.

articleTitle: Design of Urban Waterlogging Monitoring and Early Warning System Based on Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: With the acceleration of urbanisation, the problem of urban flood prevention is becoming more and more serious, and urban flooding caused by large-scale rainfall poses a serious threat to people's lives and urban infrastructure. In order to effectively deal with urban flooding, this paper proposes an urban waterlogging monitoring and early warning system based on internet of things Technology, aiming to reduce urban flooding through real-time monitoring, data analysis, intelligent early warning, and effective scheduling. This paper designs the overall architecture of the system, including hardware composition and software design, and provides an in-depth analysis of the main modules. The effectiveness of the system is verified through testing, and the results show that the system has high real-time and reliability.

articleTitle: A Complex Co-localization Local Mean Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: To address the issue of primary components intertwined with rotating assembly components during the separation process, we propose the Complex Co-localization Local Mean Decomposition method (CCLMD). This method replaces traditional linear interpolation for obtaining the average envelope function with piecewise cubic Hermite interpolation, enhancing the accuracy of local extrema identification. By applying a threshold, intrinsic mode function (IMF) components are extracted and subjected to Local Mean Decomposition (LMD). The separation process concludes once the IMF components are determined to represent pure frequency-modulated signals. Simulation results show that compared to Complex Empirical Mode Decomposition (CEMD) and Complex Local Mean Decomposition (CLMD), CCLMD effectively captures local signal characteristics, achieving up to 96.03% separation effectiveness, and maintaining 86.42% at 0 dB, with minimal fluctuation in performance due to signal-to-noise ratio variations. Experimental data further validate its effectiveness.

articleTitle: NMF-based Localization of Spatially Sparse Overlapping Coherent Distributed Sources
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In this paper, we consider the problem of locating spatially distributed sources in a complex scenario where two or more coherent sources overlap. Based on the convex optimization criterion of sound source location based on sparsity constraint, the non-negative matrix factorization (NMF) technique is introduced to realize the non-negative estimation of the spatial distribution function of distributed sources and improve the estimation accuracy. In this paper, simulation experiments are carried out under different configurations, and the results show that the method is effective.

articleTitle: Research on Automation of Standard Document Classification and Information Extraction Supported by Knowledge Graphs
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: The classification and information extraction of standard documents is a critical topic in the field of knowledge management. This study designs and implements an intelligent processing system for standard documents supported by knowledge graphs. The system employs a layered architecture and an improved deep learning model, utilizing knowledge graphs for dynamic updates of domain knowledge. The system significantly outperforms traditional methods in document classification accuracy and information extraction efficiency. Deployed using a microservice architecture, the system demonstrates excellent scalability and stability, providing an effective technical solution for intelligent management of standard documents.

articleTitle: A Hardware Implementation of Anti-noise Bayesian Deconvolution Algorithm Based on FPGA and Network Port Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In the field of computer science and engineering, hardware acceleration and encryption are key technologies for improving computing power and ensuring information security. FPGAs can be used to accelerate core algorithms and implement information encryption. This experiment focuses on the noise-resistant Bayesian deconvolution algorithm, improving its noise resistance on FPGAs, and achieving hardware acceleration and optimization. It also solves the problem of large data volume by using Ethernet instead of serial ports, significantly improving the efficiency of information processing and system security. It has important engineering significance.

articleTitle: H∞ Synchronization and Sensitivity Analysis of High-Order Complex Dynamical Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In complex dynamical networks, interactions among nodes not only represent binary relationships but also multivariate relationships. This paper investigates H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> synchronization of high-order complex dynamical networks with second-order interactions, which are characterized by 2-simplex. Based on Lyapunov stability theory, linear matrix inequality (LMI), and H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> control theory, this paper proposes sufficient conditions to achieve asymptotic H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> synchronization by adding controllers to high-order complex dynamical networks. Numerical simulations validate the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed theoretical results.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Target Tracking Data Source Optimization Method Based on Improved Prospect CRITIC-TOPSIS Model
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In order to select the optimal trajectory among multiple main station equipment for multi-target tasks, traditional methods require a high level of business capability from commanders and operators through the decision-making of tracking curves. This paper adopts the CRITIC method to comprehensively measure the objective weight of indicators based on the comparative intensity of evaluation index data and the conflict between indicators. The TOPSIS evaluation method is used to construct positive and negative ideal solutions, judge the distance between the target and the positive and negative ideal solutions, and comprehensively determine the radar tracking ranking scheme. The prospect theory is used to construct the psychological characteristic model of the commander, improving the judgment criterion of the distance between the target and the positive and negative ideal solutions in the TOPSIS model to the prospect value judgment criterion of comparative scores, and realizing the quality assessment of radar tracking trajectories at the center level based on the relative profit-loss ratio, thus optimally generating a continuous and smooth comprehensive trajectory.

articleTitle: Deep Phase Mapping 3D based on Single-Frame Digital Moiré Fringe
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: To enhance three-dimensional(3D) measurement precision with minimal fringes, the deep phase mapping 3D based on single-frame digital moiré fringe method (DDM) is proposed. By projecting just one high-frequency fringe and combining wrapped phase with fringe order to calculate continuous phase, it achieves 3D reconstruction through training on three process variables, thereby enhancing measurement precision. Experimental DDM measurements of 3D contours for fox and complex face models surpassed traditional single-frame methods in accuracy. Further evaluation on standard planes confirmed DDM's precision through lower RMSE (root mean square error) and MAE (mean absolute error) values, underlining its superior reconstruction accuracy. It holds great promise for its potential applications in real-time industrial measurements.

articleTitle: Rating Analysis and Prediction Based on K-Nearest Neighbor Regression
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: With the continuous development and progress of society, television has entered thousands of households early. In order to better analyze TV ratings, this paper proposes a rating analysis method based on K-nearest neighbor regression for the analysis and prediction of TV ratings. The method first captures the historical ratings data published on the Internet; then analyzes the original data, and visually displays the relationship between the features to be analyzed; then selects the K-nearest neighbor regression algorithm as the main basis for analysis, respectively Real-time audience rating data), audienceRatingAvg (average audience rating data), audienceRatingMax (highest audience rating data), and audienceRatingMin (minimum audience rating data) modeling to obtain the best fitting regression curve; The value of the ratings data. After many tests and analysis, the model can predict the viewership data very well, and can provide fast analysis and processing methods for those who need it.

articleTitle: Pedestrian Trajectory Intention Prediction in Autonomous Driving Scenarios Based on Spatio-temporal Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In a mixed traffic environment of human and autonomous driving, an autonomous vehicle must predict the lane change intentions and trajectories of pedestrians that pose a risk to it. Due to the uncertainty of human intentions, accurately predicting pedestrian trajectory intentions is a great challenge. This paper proposes a novel spatiotemporal attention framework for pedestrian trajectory prediction in autonomous driving scenarios. The framework consists of three key components: a spatio-temporal feature extraction module, a multi-head attention mechanism for trajectory encoding, and an intention recognition module. The intention recognition module explicitly models the relationship between trajectory Extensive experiments on the ETH-UCY and Stanford Drone datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. The proposed method significantly improves over state-of-the-art methods, with a 12.8% reduction in average displacement error and 93% intention recognition accuracy. The framework maintains real-time performance capabilities, making it suitable for practical autonomous driving applications.

articleTitle: Research on the Layout of Silicon Controlled Rectifier Electrostatic Discharge Protection Devices Based on 0.18μm CMOS Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In order to improve the performance of SCR without increasing the device area, the Silicon Controlled Rectifier (SCR) is studied from two aspects, layout drawing and process levels. the impacts of strip layout, octagonal layout, waffle circular layout and circular layout of traditional SCR on capacitance have been studied, and the influence of Dual Gate (DG) layer on the performance of traditional SCR has been investigated. All devices were implemented using 0.18μm CMOS process technology. The test results show that the SCR with circular layout has the smallest capacitance and the highest robustness, and the traditional SCR without DG have a higher holding voltage.

articleTitle: A New SPICE Model for the Electro-Thermal Behavior of GaN HEMT
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: High-precision GaN HEMT models play a crucial role in power electronics applications. Considering the limitations of silicon-based device models, which cannot be directly applied to GaN HEMTs, and the low accuracy of certain existing GaN HEMT models, a new electro-thermal model for GaN HEMTs is proposed in this paper. The model employs a logarithmic function for static modeling, providing a continuous characteristic that enhances flexibility in both positive and negative regions. Furthermore, the nonlinear expression of the drain-source capacitance C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ds</inf> is improved, achieving higher fitting accuracy in the low-voltage range. Validation through static I-V and dynamic C-V characteristics demonstrates that the model achieves high accuracy, effectively fitting waveforms across the voltage range. Finally, a double-pulse test (DPT) circuit is implemented using LTSPICE software to simulate and verify the model’s switching characteristics. The results demonstrate that the model achieves excellent performance.

articleTitle: Speech Emotion Recognition Based on Adaptive Feature Fusion Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Speech emotion recognition technology plays an indispensable role in the field of artificial intelligence, which can effectively improve the comfort of human-computer interaction. Different speech signal features can represents emotion state from different levels, and the fusion of those features can improve the performance of speech emotion recognition systems. However, the existing works lacks of effective feature fusion mechanisms, which lead to the poor performance of speech emotion recognition system. In order to address this problem, we propose a novel adaptive feature fusion network (AFFN),which can fully leverage the emotional representation capabilities of different features. In the proposed model, we designed two parallel deep learning feature extraction channels to learn mel-spectrogram and sound feature features, respectively. In the feature fusion stage, an adaptive feature fusion strategy is adopted, which can fully consider the matching performance between different features, efficiently fuse emotional features from different dimensions, and effectively improve the effectiveness of emotion recognition system. Extensive experiments are conducted on the designed AFFN based on IEMOCAP and EMODB databases, and the experimental results show that the proposed method outperforms existing feature fusion schemes in both WA and UA performance.

articleTitle: Application of AODV Protocol Based on Multi-Parameter Fusion Cost Function in Bluetooth Mesh Networking
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: This paper analyzes the defects of managed flooding and traditional AODV (Ad-hoc On-Demand Distance Vector, AODV) routing protocol in Bluetooth Mesh networking, and proposes an AODV routing protocol based on multi-parameter fusion cost function. This protocol uses the path cost function instead of the minimum hop count to select the best path. The function comprehensively considers the path hop count, node load, and node residual energy. Simulation results show that the improved protocol has significant effects in enhancing the data transmission rate and throughput of Bluetooth Mesh networks and reducing network overhead.

articleTitle: A Continuous Ramp Generator Design for Column-Parallel CMOS Image Sensors Utilizing Novel Row-wise Noise Suppression Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: This paper presents a novel continuous ramp generator designed for single-slope ADC (SS-ADC) architecture CMOS image sensors (CIS), with the aim of reducing row-wise noise. Based on traditional continuous ramp generators, two additional sampling capacitors are used to reduce the noise in the ramp reset voltage and the integration current, which can cause irregular horizontal stripes in images, especially in low-light conditions. By employing digital correlated double sampling (DCDS) techniques, the sampling capacitors sample the reset voltage and the current source bias voltage before the ramp voltage rises, ensuring that the conditions for generating the two ramp voltages are essentially the same, thereby suppressing the impact of noise fluctuations on the count value. Through the fabrication and testing of a CMOS image sensor using 350nm/55nm process, the proposed method has been proven to reduce row noise by 80%, demonstrating excellent row noise suppression performance.

articleTitle: Research on distributed cooperative silicon based photonic computing chip
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In this paper, an architecture of a photonic neural network chip with distributed multi-scenarios is presented. The distributed computing chip has five computing modules, which are characterized by three-dimensional imaging processing, convolutional operation, matrix operation, low-energy operation, and high-speed operation, respectively. Through the cooperative work of multiple modules, self-adaptive high-speed and energy-efficient computation of large-scale computing tasks can be realized.

articleTitle: Speech Recognition for Power Dispatching Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In power dispatch speech recognition, the recognition scenario is different from quiet public domains, as it involves challenges such as noisy audio signals and an abundance of technical terms. Therefore, this paper proposes an acoustic model framework to enhance the attention mechanism, using the Conformer as the sound encoder and introducing the Deep Residual Shrinkage Network to process audio signals. In the decoder part, the decoding results of CTC are fed into the Attention network for scoring again, obtaining new score rankings to achieve the output with the highest probability. Finally, a shallow fusion acoustic model based on statistical language models n-gram is utilized to further improve the overall recognition capabilities of the model for power dispatch scenario audio. A comparison with baseline models on public Mandarin datasets and power dispatch scenario audio datasets showed a reduction in Character Error Rate (CER) by 2.3 and 4.1 respectively, validating the advanced nature of the model.

articleTitle: An Improved Two Stage Fast Acquisition Method Based on Segmented FFT
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: The navigation enhancement signals in communication and navigation integration signals are characterized by limited spectrum resources and non-continuous transmission; For the high-dynamic, short-burst navigation enhancement signals in the L-band of low-earth orbit (LEO) satellites, an improved segmented Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) two-stage time-frequency domain two-dimensional fast acquisition method is proposed; Through the two-stage segmented coherent FFT acquisition process, the arrival time of the navigation enhancement signal and the signal Doppler shift estimation are obtained simultaneously, enabling fast and real-time signal acquisition processing in LEO scenarios; Simulation results demonstrate that when the signal carrier-to-noise ratio is above 48 dBHz, the fast acquisition algorithm can adapt to signal Doppler shifts of ±40 kHz and accommodate short-burst transmission modes, with the signal Doppler estimation error controlled within ±80 Hz and the signal arrival time estimation error controlled within ±0.5 chip.

articleTitle: A Joint Tactical Information Distribution System Signal Detection Method Based on Multi-level Channelization and Channel Selection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In order to detect the signals of the Joint Tactical Information Distribution System (JTIDS), a efficient multi-level channelization processing method was designed based on the existing channelized reception. By dividing the channels in the channelization model into two levels, the requirement of frequency interval of JTIDS signals was met, and the computational complexity was reduced. When performing threshold detection, the channel selection algorithm based on peak detection solved the channel ambiguity problem caused by narrowband division in the channelized reception process, and improved the accuracy of detection results.

articleTitle: Preparation of a Holographic Cylindrical Lens for Focusing Parallel Light onto a Sensor
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: This study presents the design of a holographic cylindrical lens for focusing parallel light onto a sensor, emphasizing its manufacturing process, analysis, and performance enhancements. The cylindrical lens is capable of focusing a laser beam into a linear light spot, which can be utilized for sensor imaging or detection. The results indicate that the fabricated holographic cylindrical lens fulfills the fundamental functions of a cylindrical lens while achieving a short focal length and long line effect at the same dimensions. Compared to conventional cylindrical lenses made of glass, holographic optical elements are lightweight, capable of achieving nanometer-level precision, easy to fabricate, customizable to specific application requirements, and suitable for mass production.

articleTitle: Real-Time Monitoring of Physiological Signals Using Millimeter-Wave Radar and Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: This paper presents a study on real-time monitoring technology for respiratory and heartbeat processes based on millimeter-wave radar. The core focus of this research is on achieving high real-time signal monitoring and recognition, capable of identifying the peak and smooth intervals of the respiratory process, as well as the moments of P, R, and T waves in the heartbeat process, all with minimal latency. This approach provides a more convenient and user-friendly solution for medical gating in CT, MRI, and other smart home applications. Through an in-depth investigation of millimeter-wave radar signal processing methods, an efficient algorithm for respiratory and heartbeat detection is proposed, which includes noise suppression, real-time respiratory-heartbeat separation, heartbeat signal reconstruction based on deep learning, signal peak finding, and signal gradual period identification. The algorithm is verified in real-world environments, and the fusion of traditional signal processing techniques with deep learning methods enables real-time monitoring and recognition of respiratory and heartbeat signals using cost-effective 24 GHz millimeter-wave radar.

articleTitle: Design of Low-IF Receiver for Phased Array Application
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Aiming at the needs of phased array field, this paper designed a S-band low intermediate frequency receiver which can directly process wide-band signals. Based on the hybrid integrated design scheme of active component selection and passive component design, through simulation, optimization and sample test, the gain of low intermediate frequency receiver is better than 28dB, and the noise figure is less than 3.5dB. The simulation and test results are in good agreement.

articleTitle: A LoRa Networking Method for Distributed Queue Protocol with Adaptive Competition
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Aiming at the adaptation problem of distributed queue protocol in LoRa, this paper designs an improved networking method, which realizes the recognition of contention state through node random code, and optimize the selection of contention time slots and contention groups to solve the problems of initial contention failure, excessive control overhead and low energy efficiency. The simulation results show that the improved DQ protocol is superior to the traditional ALOHA and CSMA protocols in throughput, energy consumption and network scalability. Compared with the traditional DQ-LoRa protocol, the throughput is improved by more than 7% when short data is uploaded and there are many nodes competing at the same time, which provides an effective solution for LoRa networking in the industrial Internet of Things.

articleTitle: Design of Strip Surface Defect Detection System Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In order to address the practical application issues of surface defect detection in steel strips, this paper designs a surface defect detection system based on machine vision. The detection algorithm was developed, and defect images of the steel strip surface were captured by an image acquisition device. The accuracy of detection and system stability were studied. First, an improved Faster R-CNN algorithm was adopted and trained using the NEU-DET dataset to learn the feature information of surface defects in steel strips. Then, a hardware and software platform for the detection system was built, and the defect detection performance was verified. The study shows that the detection system operates smoothly and achieves high detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Adaptive Protection Scheme for Power Grid with DFIG
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: The high penetration of distributed wind power into the distribution network makes the transient characteristics of the distribution network more complex, which makes the traditional three-stage current protection difficult to adapt. In this paper, the transient model of doubly-fed induction wind turbine is analyzed, and the mathematical relationship between stator current and stator and rotor flux linkage is obtained. The analytical expression of DFIG active power and rotor reaction flux linkage is derived by theoretical derivation, and then the relationship between the current of wind turbine (field) after fault and the active power output at the moment of fault can be derived. A new scheme of adaptive protection with adaptive active output of wind turbine (field) is proposed for the lines of wind turbine (field) distributed in distribution network. Therefore, an adaptive current quick- break protection scheme based on timely adjustment of protection action value under different treatment conditions of wind field is proposed. A large number of simulation tests are carried out on the active distribution network established by PSCAD / EMTDC software. The results show that this method can effectively solve the problem of selectivity and sensitivity of the current quick- break protection action of the distribution network at the downstream position of the wind farm access point.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Lane Detection Network Based on Adaptive Anchor Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In recent years, autonomous driving technology has become a global focus. With the aid of deep neural networks, lane detection technology has made significant progress; however, achieving accurate lane positioning remains a challenging task. Most previous work relies on predefined anchors, which somewhat limits the generalization of anchor-based methods in the field of lane detection, particularly in terms of flexibility. This paper proposes a new lightweight lane detection network based on adaptive anchor generation, named LAANet. In the framework, the Adaptive Anchor Generation Module (AAGM) predicts the starting point’s position and slope by analyzing the direction and contour of the lane lines in the image, generating anchors that are more closely aligned with the actual lane lines. The generated anchors are not only fewer in number compared to previous methods but also of higher quality than predefined anchors. To further aggregate contextual information, a Deformable Lane-aware Module (DLAM) that incorporates a channel attention mechanism is integrated to adaptively enhance useful features while suppressing irrelevant ones. This mechanism effectively eliminates redundant information, thereby further enhancing the feature representation of lane lines. Experimental results on the TuSimple dataset demonstrate that LAANet achieves competitive accuracy while maintaining a small model size of 41M.

articleTitle: Sea trial experiment of AUV obstacle recognition and localization based on multi-beam sonar
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: During underwater navigation, the AUV may encounter unknown obstacles and needs to identify them to prevent collision and avoid damage. This paper This paper improves the accuracy of real-time calculations through binary filtering, connected component segmentation based on contours, and image temporal methods, thereby enabling the identification and localization of obstacles. Finally, the experiment is verified in the actual environment. The vision computer of the lower part of the vehicle can recognize and process the obstacle information, and the control computer can receive the obstacle information in real time to control the equipment to cooperate to avoid the obstacle. The research results of this paper provide input parameters for obstacle avoidance planning, and can provide reference for real-time obstacle avoidance operations of vehicles at sea.

articleTitle: Text Classification Model Based on Dependency Attention Graph Convolution
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: We propose a text classification model based on dependency graph attention convolution, which improves the model’s accurate recognition of the text category by mining the semantic features exhibited in the structure of dependency relationships, parts of speech, and word roots among multiple words in the text. Firstly, we identify domain keywords in the text by combining LDA and manual screening. Domain keywords are specific words or phrases that describe or define the domain or category to which the text belongs, and these keywords play significant role in text classification. Secondly, we use NLTK to extract the dependency relationships, parts of speech, and word root features of each word in the text, constructing multidimensional word features by identifying different relationships between multiple words. Then, we employ GCN to mine the structural information of these features in the semantic network. Finally, these semantic information are used to determine their text category by discriminator, completing the text classification task. Experimental results indicate that the model we propose has good performance.

articleTitle: A Hybrid CNN-SEU-Net Approach for Improved Melanoma Detection in Dermoscopy Images : Combining CNN and SEU-Net for Robust Melanoma Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Melanoma is a highly aggressive form of skin cancer with high mortality rates if not diagnosed early. Accurate diagnosis poses significant challenges, particularly for nonspecialist healthcare providers, due to the complexity and variability of skin lesions. Current diagnostic methods often lack the precision needed for reliable early detection, highlighting the need for innovative solutions. This paper proposes a novel hybrid deep learning framework for melanoma detection that integrates SEU-Net and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to address these challenges. The framework begins with SEU-Net, an encoder-decoder segmentation model enhanced with skip connections and SE attention mechanisms, to generate a segmentation mask that identifies the region of interest (ROI) in dermoscopic images. The segmentation mask is multiplied with the original image to isolate the lesion area, creating a segmented image that minimizes irrelevant background information. This segmented image is then passed to a CNN, classifying the lesion as malignant or benign. The proposed approach was evaluated on the ISBI 2016 dataset, achieving an accuracy of 93.60\%, outperforming existing state-of-the-art methods. These results demonstrate the potential of the proposed framework to significantly improve the precision and reliability of melanoma diagnosis, enabling earlier detection and ultimately reducing mortality rates.

articleTitle: Enhanced ISAC with Terahertz-Assisted STARS: A Comprehensive Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: This paper presents a terahertz-enabled integrated sensing and communications (ISAC) system enhanced by a simultaneously transmitting and reflecting surface (STARS). By leveraging STARS to partition space into distinct zones, the system ensures communication quality while employing specialized sensors to capture echoes for high-precision target detection. The study considers constraints on user communication, transmit power, and STARS amplitude and phase, aiming to minimize the Cramer-Rao Lower Bound (CRB). To address the coupled variable challenges in the optimization, a Terahertz-STARS Hybrid Optimization (TSHO) algorithm is proposed, decoupling the objective into solvable sub-problems. Simulations validate the algorithm’s convergence and demonstrate that terahertz technology significantly boosts ISAC system detection capabilities without compromising communication performance, enabling comprehensive spatial services.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Techniques for Pattern Recognition in High-Dimensional Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: This paper proposes a frequent pattern data mining algorithm based on support vector machine (SVM), aiming to solve the performance bottleneck of traditional frequent pattern mining algorithms in high-dimensional and sparse data environments. By converting the frequent pattern mining task into a classification problem, the SVM model is introduced to improve the accuracy and robustness of pattern extraction. In terms of method design, the kernel function is used to map the data to a high-dimensional feature space, so as to construct the optimal classification hyperplane, realize the nonlinear separation of patterns and the accurate mining of frequent items. In the experiment, two public datasets, Retail and Mushroom, were selected to compare and analyze the proposed algorithm with traditional FP-Growth, FP-Tree, decision tree and random forest models. The experimental results show that the algorithm in this paper is significantly better than the traditional model in terms of three key indicators: support, confidence and lift, showing strong pattern recognition ability and rule extraction effect. The study shows that the SVM model has excellent performance advantages in an environment with high data sparsity and a large number of transactions, and can effectively cope with complex pattern mining tasks. At the same time, this paper also points out the potential direction of future research, including the introduction of deep learning and ensemble learning frameworks to further improve the scalability and adaptability of the algorithm. This research not only provides a new idea for frequent pattern mining, but also provides important technical support for solving pattern discovery and association rule mining problems in practical applications.

articleTitle: Multimodal Hybrid Healthcare Recommendation System Based on ERT-MOE and Large Language Model enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: With the explosion of information and the development of information technology, advanced architectures that can effectively integrate and process diverse data sources have attracted widespread attention and demand in the industry. This study proposes a recommendation model for healthcare with a hybrid architecture, which integrates the most advanced large language model and multimodal data, and introduces an entity recognition transformer (ERT) to extract entities and relations in patient descriptions, and introduces a MOE model to enhance the classification performance of the neural matrix factorization model. This study uses a small dataset to test the recommendation of healthy food based on user symptom descriptions. The experimental results show that the hybrid model outperforms the baseline model of its components in all indicators of personalized recommendation effects. The research results provide an effective way to develop customized recommendation systems and promote the constructive contribution of recommendation technology in practical fields such as guidance and self-examination.

articleTitle: Reconstruction Method for Radio Fuze Signals Based on Compressed Sensing
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In response to the challenges posed by the advancement of radio fuze towards millimeter-wave and higher frequency bands, which enhance target detection accuracy and anti-jamming capabilities, this paper addresses the resulting burdens on signal reception, storage, and transmission. Under constraints of limited hardware resources and costs, we propose a reconstruction method for sampled data based on compressed sensing, leveraging the frequency domain sparsity of radio echoes. This approach aims to reduce the equivalent sampling rate of the received signals, thereby alleviating storage and transmission loads. The method employs an observation matrix for compressive sampling and utilizes the interior-point method to solve the convex optimization problem inherent in the reconstruction of sparse coefficients. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method significantly reduces the equivalent sampling rate of the receiver and mitigates data storage and transmission pressures while maintaining signal accuracy. This provides a technological foundation for the efficient and cost-effective implementation of signal processing in radio fuze.

articleTitle: Study on Satellite Self-testing Technology Based on Onboard Computers
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In satellite system-level testing, numerous test items rely on ground-sent remote control commands and subsequent telemetry parameter interpretation to assess the health and functional accuracy of satellite systems. Such testing spans various stages, including factory electrical testing, before and after large-scale testing, pre-shipment preparation, and launch site preparation, and requires frequent repetition. However, ground testing is limited by the communication rate between the satellite and the ground, as well as delays in command generation and telemetry analysis, which hampers efficiency. Given the increasing mass production of satellites, the traditional ground testing model, characterised by its intensity, low efficiency, and repetitive manual processes, is becoming inadequate for meeting the rising demands. To address this issue, we propose an innovative satellite Self-testing technology based on onboard computers. These onboard computers not only handle the parsing of remote control commands but also integrate and downlink all satellite telemetry parameters, laying a solid foundation for implementing satellite self-testing. Furthermore, this approach overcomes the limitations of the satellite-ground communication link rate, facilitates high-speed information exchange, and significantly enhances testing efficiency, offering substantial practical benefits.

articleTitle: Miniature Broadband Zero-Order Resonance Antenna for WiMAX Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: As electronic devices continue to trend towards high integration and miniaturization, the available space for antennas is shrinking rapidly, posing a severe challenge to antenna design. It is imperative to achieve a significant reduction in physical size to meet the stringent requirements of practical application scenarios. This paper proposes a design for a miniaturized, broadband zero-order resonant antenna. By adopting an asymmetric grounded meander line structure, the antenna's bandwidth range is successfully broadened, and effective miniaturization of the antenna structure is achieved. Furthermore, the introduction of a stepped capacitance structure enables good impedance matching within the 3.3~4.9 GHz frequency band, with a radiation efficiency exceeding 90%. Therefore, it becomes an ideal choice for WiMAX wireless communication systems.

articleTitle: Designing an Enhanced APUF Structure Optimized for FPGA Implementation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: With the rapid advancement of the semiconductor field, hardware security has become increasingly critical. Physical Unclonable Functions (PUFs), due to their unclonable and unpredictable characteristics, have emerged as a promising solution in hardware security applications. However, as technology progresses and research on attacks against PUFs deepens, the susceptibility of PUFs to modeling attacks has become evident. This paper proposes a novel obfuscation scheme that utilizes the original inputs and outputs to control key selection, thereby obfuscating the mapping between challenges and responses. This approach signifivantly enhances the resistance of PUFs to machine learning-based modeling attacks. The proposed design has been successfully implemented on an FPGA. Experimental results show that the proposed PUF structure achieves high reliability, uniformity, and randomness while effectively resisting a range of common machine learning attack methods.

articleTitle: Bird Recognition in Urban Ecological Areas Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: With the swift development of technology, image recognition based on deep learning has become known to a wider public and grows mature gradually, which can be used in different fields such as face, vehicle, animal and plant recognition. This research focuses on bird image classification and recognition in urban ecological areas which constructs ResNet-50 model to classify and identify 20 species of birds. It summarises the existing research relevant to deep learning and introduces theoretical principles of ResNet-50 model. It aims to improve the efficiency and accuracy of image recognition. Based on this research, ornithologists can make better and more specific strategies for bird protection according to different species in order to improve ecological environment. As for the results, the accuracy and loss ratios of every training session are calculated and displayed using line charts. Besides, all bird images are marked as the name of its species and are determined if the label is true. The research achievement can be applied to the development of other fields with the recognition techniques of images.

articleTitle: Multi-Intent Learning for Multi-Modal Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Recommendation Systems play an increasingly important role in social platforms, providing users with personalized content services. With the explosive growth of multi-modal contents, traditional recommendation systems based solely on interaction data can no longer meet user needs. In recent years, many researchers have attempted to integrate multi-modal features into recommendation system. Meanwhile, user intent determines whether users will interact with items or not. Intent modeling is crucial for capturing user preferences and explaining recommendation results. Recommendation system based on interaction data model user intents at a coarse-grained level, because the information contained in user IDs and item IDs is too limited. In contrast, multi-modal features can reflect finer-grained user preferences from a semantic perspective. To address this issue, we propose a Multi-Intent Learning method for Multi-Modal Recommendation (MIMM). Specifically, we design a Modality-Specific Intent Graph Convolution Network to disentangle user and item intents from different modalities and filter out self-supervision signals at the semantic level. Finally, a cross-modality intent contrastive learning task is introduced to align user intents across different modality. Experiments on real-world dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of our MIMM.

articleTitle: A new framework for GNSS spoofing detection based on signal phase and structure
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Spoofing interference casts significant threat to the GNSS receivers making the enhancement of spoofing detection capability a crucial issue. Detection performance of traditional SQM method encounters evident degradation in interference process. Utilizing phase feature and specific structure of spoofing signal, a new spoofing detection framework has been developed to determine the existence of interference. Preliminary experimental results in TEXBAT indicate that this method owns great potential in spoofing detection, maintaining stability and accuracy in different stages of interference.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of a Novel LVTSCR Triggered SCR Device for 5-V Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: The conventional low voltage triggered silicon-controlled rectifier (LVTSCR) has a relatively low holding voltage (V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">h</inf>), so it is susceptible to latch-up risks when the operating voltage is 5 V. In this paper, we studied a modified electrostatic discharge protection device called LVTSCR triggered SCR (LVTSCRTSCR), which consists of the conventional LVTSCR on one side and the conventional SCR structure on the other side. To further enhance the V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">h</inf> of LVTSCRTSCR, we designed a new device named ILVTSCRTSCR, which has an embedded parasitic NPN transistor based on the LVTSCRTSCR. These devices were all developed in a 0.18 μm CMOS technology, and their operation mechanisms were explored and analyzed by TCAD simulations. In addition, these devices have been verified by the TLP testing system. The results show that compared to the conventional LVTSCR, the ILVTSCRTSCR has a higher V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">h</inf>. By further optimizing a crucial structure parameter of the ILVTSCRTSCR device, the V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">h</inf> could exceed 5.5 V. Consequently, the ILVTSCRTSCR is a prospective ESD protection device for 5 V I/O.

articleTitle: Research on Networked Communication in Multi-AUV Cluster Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: With the continuous advancement of Autonomous underwater vehicles (AUV) technology, the capabilities of a single AUV are increasingly limited, making it difficult to meet demands of comprehensive mission execution. To address this challenge, this study adaptively modified three heavy-duty AUV to construct an autonomous underwater cluster system. A multidisciplinary optimization approach was employed to refine the design of the modified AUV platforms. By analysing the characteristics of the acoustic channel, Evologics acoustic modems were selected, and the communication system was subsequently optimized. Finally, lake trials were conducted to validate the networked communication functionality of the multi-AUV cluster system. The experimental results demonstrate that the system can effectively track the navigation trajectories of each AUV, confirming the correctness and effectiveness of the networked communication functions and protocols.

articleTitle: Automatic Test Cases Generation Based on SysML Activity Diagram
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) is a widely-adopted methodology in the intricate realm of system design, leveraging models to foster collaborative design and development endeavors. System Modeling Language (SysML) has emerged as the preeminent modeling language within MBSE, underscoring its significance. It is imperative to equip developers with comprehensive SysML-based design-level testing capabilities. This paper introduces an automated approach to generating test cases from SysML activity diagrams, addressing challenges such as state explosion and inadequate test coverage. The proposed method involves the automated analysis of activity diagram structures, followed by the generation of test paths based on these analyses. Subsequently, these test paths are integrated with test data to form and refine test cases.

articleTitle: 108/140/171 GHz multi-mode multi-frequency gyrotron output window design
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: For multi-frequency operation, the output windows are required to have excellent transmission for all operating frequencies. The output windows for 108/140/171 GHz multi-mode multi-frequency gyratory have been designed with Boron Nitride as the material and the design parameters are given so that the output windows can efficiently transmit high power microwaves at 108 GHz, 140 GHz and 171 GHz. The reflection coefficients S11 are less than -20 dB in the frequency bands 106.71-108.57 GHz, 138.72-140.58 GHz, and 171.33-173.23 GHz.

articleTitle: DSAFN: Dual-Stream Attention Temporal-Spatial Fusion Network for Human Activity Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Human activity recognition (HAR) technology plays a vital role in the field of mobile computing. With the advancement of mobile device intelligence, the number of sensors carried by wearable devices such as smart watches is also increasing, which greatly improves the model's ability to recognize intricate human behaviors. Nevertheless, this advancement also raises the problem of data heterogeneity, which causes the model to encounter the difficulty of data distribution alignment when fusing multi-modal data across different individuals. This paper proposes a dualstream attention temporal-spatial fusion network for Human Activity Recognition (DSFAN) to fully extract the spatio-temporal features of activity data, and then fuses the features of different modalities based on the attention mechanism to extract domain-invariant features to achieve unsupervised domain adaption (UDA). In addition, we conducted experiments on three public HAR datasets to verify the superiority of our proposed model over other models.

articleTitle: Research and Analysis on Image Reconstruction Algorithm Based on Compressed Sensing
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Compressed Sensing (CS) is an efficient signal processing technique that can accurately acquire and reconstruct signals at lower sampling rates exploiting the sparsity of the signals. In the field of image processing, compressed sensing image reconstruction algorithms utilize the sparse representation of images to recover the original image from small number of observations. The core of this algorithm lies in the sparse representation of the signal, the construction of the observation matrix, and the selection of the reconstruction. First, it is assumed that the original image can be sparsely represented in a certain sparse basis, such as wavelet transform or sparse dictionary. Then the sparse coefficients are randomly sampled to obtain the observations. Finally, the image is reconstructed using a compressed sensing algorithm based on the sampling data and the observation matrix. performance of the reconstruction algorithm is affected by factors such as the sparsity of the signal, the design of the observation matrix, and the selection of the reconstruction algorithm To improve the reconstruction performance, various improved algorithms have been proposed in recent years, such as the iterative hard thresholding algorithm with variable step size and the deep learning image compressed sensing algorithm.

articleTitle: Recognition and Prediction of Human Actions in Industrial Human-Robot Collaboration Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: This paper focuses on human action recognition in human-robot collaboration (HRC) scenarios, specifically investigating human motion recognition and human motion prediction in industrial environments. It employs a 3D convolutional neural network (3D CNN) for action recognition and integrates Transformer, LSTM, and DyHead mechanisms to construct a human motion prediction model, enabling the prediction of future human movements. The system collects video data from a simulated wire harness assembly scene to enhance the robotic arm's dynamic obstacle avoidance capabilities and ensure operational safety in industrial settings. Experimental results demonstrate that the system effectively improves safety and operational efficiency in complex HRC scenarios.

articleTitle: An Analysis of the Current Situation of Foreign Minimum Communications
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: As the nerve center to guarantee all kinds of information systems, communication system must ensure unblocked at all times. As the last guarantee to ensure unblocked communication, communication system plays an important role. This paper analyzes the construction, use and development of the minimum communication system in the United States and Russia, aiming to give some enlightenment to the construction and development of our country.

articleTitle: High-Speed Data Processing System for Optical Analog-to-Digital Converters
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Optical Analog-to-Digital Converters (OADC) are devices that directly convert analog optical signals into digital signals. This research has designed an embedded high-speed data acquisition system for OADC using Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGA). The main control chip utilizes the Xilinx Virtex UltraScale series VU9P FPGA, employs GTY IP cores for high-speed data reception, and implements algorithms for high-speed serial data input alignment. The Adsantec ANST7122-KMA flash ADC chip is used to perform the analog-to-digital conversion function. The acquired data is stored in Block RAM resources of FPGA and then uploaded to the host computer via the UART serial port. The data processing system board can synchronously collect signals from five channels. The experimental results show that the system can realize 10GSps data sampling with a sampling accuracy of 4.3 bit@1.1GHz. and continuously sample 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">16</sup> points. The system integrates data acquisition, data processing, and data transmission onto a single board, offering an architecture with high integration and portability.

articleTitle: Federated Recommendation with Integrated Dynamic Negative Sampling
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: The importance of recommendation system to solve the problem of information overload in the Internet era is self-evident. Implicit feedback is an important data source of recommendation system. By mining and analyzing implicit feedback data, recommendation system can provide better services. However, the wide application of recommendation system also makes the problem of user privacy protection increasingly prominent. The existing recommendation model often uses all the data of users for training, and does not take into account the subjective will of users, but users may not want to share all the data for security reasons. In addition, the proportion of negative samples in implicit feedback recommendation data is large, and random sampling is difficult for the recommendation model to learn useful information and make effective recommendations. To address the above shortcomings, this paper proposes a federal recommendation algorithm DNSFBPR, which integrates dynamic negative sampling strategy to select negative samples more effectively for the model, and designs a user control strategy on the client side to allow users to control whether private data is shared, while using homomorphic encryption to protect uploaded gradient information. Experimental results show that the proposed method can improve the recommendation performance while protecting user privacy.

articleTitle: Research on AI-Driven Adaptive Laser Bird Deterrence System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: This study explores the development of an AI-driven adaptive laser bird deterrence system, aiming to enhance bird deterrence efficiency and adaptability through the integration of artificial intelligence technologies. The system uses adaptive control algorithms to dynamically adjust laser intensity and frequency based on real-time bird activity, improving its deterrence effectiveness and precision. The analysis indicates that the system can significantly increase the success rate of bird deterrence under various environmental conditions. The research provides valuable insights into the application of this technology in multiple fields, including power transmission lines and related industries, offering an effective solution to bird damage.

articleTitle: Design and application of road surface snow cover AI intelligent detection system
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: In terms of road snow detection, the existing snow detection methods have a series of problems, such as low detection accuracy and poor real-time performance. In order to solve this problem, the road surface snow AI intelligent detection system is designed. The system collects road pictures, snow depth, temperature and humidity, longitude and longitude in real time through intelligent detection box, and detects the snow situation on the road surface through AI intelligent detection algorithm, realize accurate automatic processing and visual management of snow on the road surface, and reduce manual intervention. Experiments prove that this system has wide application prospects and can adapt to different scenarios and requirements.

articleTitle: Multi-Source Correlation Data Traffic Prediction Based on TextCNN and BiLSTM Model
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Predicting traffic flow at different highway nodes can provide operational staff with basis for control measures. Current model only predicts the traffic flow for a single node and cannot capture the traffic flow information of different related nodes.To tackle this issue, this paper presents a model that combines the TextCNN and BiLSTM architectures while incorporating features derived from multi-source correlation data. Through online testing on the Hangzhou-Shaoxing-Taizhou highway (Taizhou Section) in Zhejiang Province,The experimental results demonstrate that this model effectively captures traffic flow characteristics from neighboring nodes. which is better than other models. Specifically, compared to the Historical Average Algorithm, the RMSE result improved by approximately 36.29%, and the MAE result improved by about 31.59%.

articleTitle: The Design and Research of a 28 GHz TE12 Mode Second Harmonic Gyrotron with Iris Cavity
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: The gyrotron is the microwave source device, and the utilization of harmonic operation to reduce its operating magnetic field is a critical development direction for the gyrotron. This paper presents the theory research of a gyrotron at second harmonic with frequency of 28 GHz. We choose TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</inf> mode as the working mode, and adopt iris structure as the optimization structure to improve the quality factor of the resonant cavity to obtain high efficiency microwave energy output. A self-developed cold-cavity code is utilized to study the characteristics of the resonator cavity, and the linear theory about beam wave interaction of gyrotron and nonlinear theory about beam wave interaction of gyrotron are used to research the mode competition among different modes. After detailed numerical calculations, we finally obtain a gyrotron that can obtain a microwave energy output at operating efficiency of 32.1% and outpower of 14.45 kW.

articleTitle: FSRNet: Facial Structural-aware Representation Learning for Facial Expression Recognition via Swin Transformers
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Dynamic facial expression recognition (DFER) is an essential upstream task in the areas of human-machine interaction, driving safety, education and health aids. However, the inherent uncertainty between variations significantly impacts the effectiveness of DFER in practical applications, particularly due to the similar facial changes associated with different facial expressions. To address this challenge, we introduced a novel relationship-driven approach based on the Transformer architecture that can learn the relationships between facial expressions and facial variations. Specifically, we designed several facial variation tokens to explicitly encode the variation status of key facial regions. In addition, we developed a novel module to model the interactions between facial variation tokens and help the model better focus on the specific facial variations of facial expressions. Experimental results on two challenging benchmark DFER datasets show that our proposed FSRNet achieves state-of-the-art performance.

articleTitle: Non-Volatile Memory Express (NVMe) Resource Pooling Mechanism Based on PCIe
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: With the rapid development of big data and cloud computing technologies, the demand for storage system performance is constantly increasing.This paper explores the PCIe-based NVMe resource pooling mechanism, aiming to improve the performance and scalability of modern data center storage systems. By designing a multi-node interconnection mechanism, the cross-node sharing and dynamic allocation of NVMe device resources are realized by using PCIe NTB card. Studies include virtual injection of remote devices, remote access to BARs, and interrupt message remapping to ensure that remote devices can be effectively recognized by the operating system. Tests showed that remote shared NVMe device performance was close to local devices, verifying the feasibility of the design.The designed PCIe-based NVMe resource pooling and sharing mechanism is tested, and the final BW and IOPS performance results are analyzed, and the BW and IOPS performance of random read remote shared NVMe operation is 95% higher than that of local NVMe devices. The BW and IOPS performance of the Random Write remote shared NVMe operation is 90% higher than that of the local NVMe device. In the NVMe resource pooling and sharing mechanism, remote shared NVMe disks can be used instead of local NVMe disks.

articleTitle: A Scalable and Low Data Loss Asynchronous Readout Circuit for SPAD Arrays
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: The data loss caused by photon event stacking in asynchronous readout has become an urgent problem to be solved. A scalable asynchronous readout circuit for SPAD arrays with column-shared TDC is proposed, which is based on the addresses and timestamps of SPAD pixels, without relying on arbiters. It is approximately assumed that there is the same time information of pixels when multiple pixels respond simultaneously to photon stacking. At the cost of increasing a small amount of data processing, theoretically achieving zero loss of valid data during readout process. And the design was simulated on FPGA to verify the correctness of the functionality.

articleTitle: Integration and Configuration of LDPC IP Cores in FPGAs
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Low-density parity check (LDPC) coding is an efficient error-correction coding technique that is widely used in modern wireless communication systems, especially excelling in high signal-to-noise ratio environments. With the increased demand for high-speed data transmission and low latency in wireless communications, LDPC coding has become a key technique to improve the performance of communication systems. In this paper, we discuss the integration and configuration of LDPC IP cores in FPGAs, focus on the integration strategy to implement the LDPC encoding and decoding process on FPGA platforms, propose an optimized integration scheme, and validate its effectiveness in 5G applications through tests. The study aims to provide theoretical basis and practical guidance for the application of LDPC coding in future FPGA designs, and to promote the wide application of this technology in the field of wireless communications.

articleTitle: Analysis and application of human thermal comfort modeling in hot summer and cold winter areas
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: When the indoor thermal environment changes, the human body adapts to these changes through a series of physiological adjustments, so physiological parameters are also used as indicators to evaluate thermal comfort. However, research on automated judgment of thermal comfort is still not perfect. As thermal sensation is an important expression of thermal comfort, this study selected an environment of 19.6 °C -32.5 °C for the experiments. The results indicate that there is the strongest correlation between hand temperature and thermal sensation. When there is only one feature, selecting the hand as the feature input, the accuracy of LR (Logistic Regression) and SVM (Support Vector Machine) models reaches 0.72. When there are many features, selecting eyes, cheeks, hands or eyes, nose, cheeks, hands as feature inputs, the accuracy of using the random forest model reaches 0.8. Finally, the use of images effectively identifies body parts and obtains temperature, achieving automated thermal comfort prediction. To provide some theoretical support for thermal comfort research through the study of human temperature and thermal comfort.

articleTitle: The Design of Signal Denoising and Event Location Method based on OTDR
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer Communication (EIECC)
abstract: Optical time domain reflectometer (OTDR) is a device that uses Fresnel reflection and Rayleigh scattering principles for optical fiber detection, which is widely used in the fields of fiber characteristic measurement, fiber event localization and fiber link quality assessment. However, during the testing process, the OTDR signal is often affected by system thermal noise, scattering noise, dark current noise, and environmental noise, especially when the interference is strong, the event localization becomes difficult, which seriously affects the reliability of the detection results. In addition, the traditional event localization methods usually have the problems of complicated process and low localization accuracy.
